tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ji lta ba'i mngon rtogs gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ji lta ba'i mngon rtogs gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i 'phreng ba ji lta ba'i mngon rtogs gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkar po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs med zhabs nas bla ma'i bar// rgyud sde'i gsang ba 'byed pa la// lag na rdo rje can lta bu// rim par byon la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs pa'i phreng ba zhes bya'i gzhung*// kun gyis 'dzin bder byed pa la// pad+ma dkar po bdag 'os snyam// mkhas pa snga mas btang snyoms mdzad// bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje tho ba nag po dang ral gri/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje'i dbyug pa dkar po dang nag po/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/

bden bral du dbyug sngon can nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis dbyug pa sngon po dang ral gri rlung du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rtse gsum dang ral gri/ dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo ser po dang ral gri/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor can/ 'dod rgyal/ mi g.yo ba/ gnod mdzes rnams rin po che'i rgyan can 'gying ba mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ lhag ma rnams mi sdug pa'i gzugs can zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku bongs thung zhing yan lag rags pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag po'i dbu rgyan can/ nyi ma'i 'od can rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pas khams gsum mtha' yas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs brlag par byed pa/ g.yon brkyang gis rtsibs kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i pad nyi la gnas pa/ 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku gur kum gyi mdog can dmar ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che las byas pa'i cod pan sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer mtha' yas pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ de'i shar gyi phyogs su rnam snang dang*/ mer spyan ma gnyis dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dkar po dang ral gri/ lhor rin 'byung dang dbang ldan du sgrol ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ma rā ga ta zur dgu pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dang rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ bden bral du ma mā kī sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ut+pal dmar po dang ral gri/ bzhi po'i g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ lha khyams kyi mer gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rin po che'i me long dang ral gri/ srin por sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pi wang sngon po dang ral gri/ gnyis po'i g.yon nor bu dang pad+ma/ rlung du dri rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis dri chab kyi dung chos dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang chu skyes/ dbang ldan du ro rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ro'i snod dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ de thams cad rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa rnam snang dang lha mo bcu zla ba/

gzhan rnams nyi ma la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su reg bya rdo rje ma ljang mo ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis gos sna tshogs dang ral gri/ g.yas logs su chos dbyings rdo rje ma dkar mo cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis chos 'byung dkar po dang ral gri/ gnyis po'i g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje tho ba nag po dang ral gri/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje'i dbyug pa dkar po dang nag po/ nub sgor pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ gsum po g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ bzhi po mi sdug pa'i gzugs can zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku bongs thung zhing yan lag rags pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ g.yon brkyang gis nyi ma la gnas pa/ thabs rnams rtsa ba'i phyag rang 'od kyi rigs ma dang*/ lha mo rnams rang 'od kyi yab la 'khyud pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la ral gri'i yu bar zla ba la māṃ/ sangs rgyas bzhi'i thugs ka nas rang rang gi phyag mtshan bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/

lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu ba byas pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ zhes bsgom zhing gsal btab/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje mi bskyod pa ma mā kī lta bu la ut+pal dmar po'i tshab tu rdo rje/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dus pa rnam par snang mdzad dkar po// shar du mi bskyod pa/ mer reg bya rdo rje ma/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su spyan ma/ dbus su gsang ba 'dus pa rin 'byung*/ lhor mi bskyod pa/ bden bral du reg bya rdo rje ma/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su ma mā kī /dbus su bcom ldan 'das gsang ba 'dus pa 'od dpag med dkar po g.yas g.yon nag dmar ba'i/ phyag mtshan gyi 'od zer gyis 'od dpag med bzhin/ nub tu mi bskyod pa/ rlung du reg bya rdo rje ma/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su gos dkar mo// dbus su gsang ba 'dus pa don yod grub pa/ byang du mi bskyod dbang ldan du reg bya rdo rje/ shar sgo'i g.yon logs su sgrol ma/ oṃ āḥmāṃ hūṃ/ 'jam rdor/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dh+ṝkhūm̐/ mi bskyod pa/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzik hūṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o// oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛk hūm̐/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi'o// oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥k hūṃ/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi'o// oṃ āḥpradzñā dh+ṝka hūm̐/ don yod grub pa'i 'o// oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐/ las thams cad pa'o// gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/

de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ mer mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ bden bral du 'dod pa'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dgra sta zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ rlung du dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dgra sta/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/

g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan can/ dbang ldan du stobs po che nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rtse gsum dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/ de thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyangs can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing smin ma ag tshoms mer 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan te go rim bzhin du/ rdo rje ro langs ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang*/ sna tshogs rin chen ma dang*/ khro gnyer can ma dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ral gcig ma dang*/ sna tshogs las ma dang*/ nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang*/ sa 'dzin ma rnams la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang gis rtsibs kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i pad nyi la gnas pa/ 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na khro bo'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu// rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i prog zhu dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can rang 'dra ba'i yum reg bya rdo rje ma la 'khyud pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ling tshe shar du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ rin chen tog ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ling tshe lhor zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ mtha' yas rdo rje can dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas nas pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa ling tshe nub tu zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ don yod rdo rje can ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang*/ nor bu/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe byang du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rnam snang gi dbu brgyan pa ling tshe mer zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/

ma mā kī nag mo nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje rtse dgu /'khor lo/ ut+pal sngon po/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ling tshe srin por zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos ut+pal kha 'byed pa dang*/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas nas ut+pal dmar po/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe rlung du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngo ser/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe dbang ldan du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis me long*/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje/ ut+pal dkar po/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe'i phyi mer zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ sgra rdo rje ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi wang brdung ba/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo/ ut+pal sngon po/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa ling tshe'i phyi srin por zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ dri rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis dri'i dung chos/ lhag ma'i g.yas rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe'i phyi rlung du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ ro rdo rje ma ljang khu ljang nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis ro bcud kyi snod/ lhag ma'i g.yas 'khor lo/ ut+pal dmar po/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa ling tshe'i phyi dbang ldan du zla ba la bzhugs par gyur/ bzhi ka'i g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin chen/

ral gri/ byams pa dang sa snying dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ rin chen/ ral gri/ byams pa'i g.yas dang po klu shing gi me tog rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa lha snam nang ma'i shar du/ phyag rdor dang nam snying ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na nor bu/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa lha snam nang ma'i lhor 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dbyangs dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum gyi dang pos pad+ma kha 'byed pa/ lhag mas rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang bcas nas pad dmar/ rin chen/ ral gri/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa lha snam nang ma'i nub tu/ sgrib sel dang kun bzang ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ pad ljang nor bu/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa lha snam nang ma'i byang du/ de thams cad zhi ba rin po che dang*/ dar gyis klubs pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis 'od zer phreng ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra sta rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa shar sgor/ shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra sta/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa lho sgor/ pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/

g.yon pa gsum na dril bu/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa nub sgor/ bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa byang sgor/ mi g.yo ba mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po mthing nag mthing dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa bden bral du/ dbyug pa sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ dgra sta/ 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan pa rlung du/ stobs po che nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ dgra sta/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan pa byang shar du/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje// pad+ma// g.yon gnyis kyis sdigs mdzub/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa steng du/ gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ g.yon pa gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can 'og tu/ thams cad kyang shin tu khros pa'i zhal gdangs shing drag po'i gad rgyangs can// mche ba gtsigs pa/

spyan dmar po gsum gzir zhing smin ma ag tshom mer 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan te go rim bzhin du/ rdo rje ro langs ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang*/ sna tshogs rin chen ma dang*/ khro gnyer can ma dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ral gcig ma dang*/ sna tshogs las ma dang*/ nam mkha'i rdo rje ma dang*/ sa 'dzin ma rnams la 'khyud pa/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas me'i phung po gcig tu 'bar ba'i dbus na pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' longs sku'i bdag nyid dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bzung nas rang gi shes rab ma dang kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas lus thams cad tshim par byed pa de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po'o// de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ kha sbyor rdor sems ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi /de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la gshin rje gshed phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i lcags kyu/

'khor lo/ rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dril bu/ dgra sta/ shes rab mthar byed phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i zhags pa/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum snying gar sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ dgra sta/ pad+ma mthar byed phyag g.yas pa gsum lcags sgrog pad+ma ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum sdigs mdzub/ dril bu/ zhags pa'o// bgegs mthar byed phyag g.yas pa gsum rdo rje dril bu/ rdo rje rgya gram/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gtun shing dgra sta/ mi g.yo ba phyag g.yas pa gsum na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum sdigs mdzub/ dgra sta/ zhags pa/ 'dod rgyal phyag dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis lcags kyu/ ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dbyug pa sngon po phyag g.yas pa gsum rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyis zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dgra sta/ stobs po che phyag g.yas pa gsum rtse gsum/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dgra sta/ gtsug tor kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub/ ral gri/ gnod mdzes phyag g.yas pa gsum rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ g.yon pa gsum snying gar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ pad+ma/ ral gri/ thams cad thod pa'i cod pan dang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i do shal phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ go rim bzhin du shar nas g.yas skor dang steng 'og tu gnas pa de'i lte ba'i nang du rlung me chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa'i bar/ chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i sku mdog dkar po cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog nag po la gnas pa'i nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i 'og g.yon ngos la zla tshes/ sangs rgyas lnga yi cod pan can/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud cing chu skyes la mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba dang ldan pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang*/ lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i 'od can sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ thod pa dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad zla la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dkar dmar sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje dril bur bcas pa'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i rang bzhin hūṃ nag po'o// shar du rnam snang dkar po zhi ba phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis 'khor lo/ dril bu/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rin po che dang*// lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mda' dang pad+ma/ g.yon gnyis gzhu dang*/ zhags pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa/ dbang ldan du spyan ma dkar mo phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa bzhi 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi thod pa/ dril bu/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ mer ma mā kī sngon mo phyag bcu g.yas pa lnga/ mda'/

ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rin po che dang pad+ma/ g.yon lnga gzhu/ lcags kyu/ dril bu/ zhags pa dang bcas nas thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bden bral du gos dkar mo dmar mo phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis mda' dang pad+ma/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon bzhi/ gzhu/ thod pa/ zhags pa/ dril bu/ rlung du sgrol ma ljang khu phyag brgyad g.yas bzhis ut+pal dmar po dang ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi 'khor lo/ zhags pa/ thod pa/ gzhu/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar gyi phyogs rdo rje drag mo dkar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis gzhu dang byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa/ lhor gzugs ma ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyi rdo rje dang mdung*/ g.yon gnyis rdo rje'i zhags pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis chus gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu/ byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang khu phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis tal dogs pa pa thung du dang ba dan rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis dbyug tho dang ut+pal/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang ḍā ma ru/ mer rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang me long*/ g.yon gnyis rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ dgra sta/ bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma sngo dmar phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis shak+ti dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ rlung du sa'i rdo rje ma dkar ljang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa dang*/ dril bu/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar du bzhad ma dmar mo rdor dril 'dzin pa mngon par bzhad pa'i tshul/ lhor sgeg ma sngon mo rdor dril 'dzin pa snyems pa dang bcas pa sgeg mo'i tshul/

nub tu glu ma ser mo cung zad g.yo zhing sgeg pa'i phyag gis ting shag byang du gar ma ljang khu pad skor la sogs pa gar gyis g.yo ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum dang dril bu/ dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo/ mer pi waṃ ma ser mo/ bden bral du mu kun da dkar mo/ rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can bzhi po sgeg pa'i nyams bag tsam gyis g.yo ba rang rang gi rol mo brdung ba/ snam bu'i mer/ me tog ma dkar mo 'khor lo dang me tog gi 'phreng ba/ bden bral du bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can rin po che dang spos snod/ rlung du mar me ma gser mdog pad+ma dang*/ mar me'i snod/ dbang ldan du dri chab ma dmar mo ral gri dang dri'i dung chos/ shar du me long ma dkar mo me long*/ lhor ro ma dmar mo ro bcud/ nub tu reg bya rdo rje ma ljang khu gos sna tshogs/ byang du chos ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin pa/ rnam snang la sogs pa lha de thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum pa cod pan nag po thod pa lnga 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan pa lha'i na bza' can skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha'i mdog sngon mo sngo nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams lcags kyu ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon rnams zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams 'khor lo/ dril bu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams lcags sgrog rdo rje ral gri/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu ljang nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams dril bu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ gsum po'i g.yon rnams 'khor lo/ dril bu/ lcags kyu/ bzhi ka'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/

rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ thod pa la dung 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan cing stag sham can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ sgo ba dang sangs rgyas rnams sna tshogs pad+ma dang thod pa dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o// gzhan rnams pad+ma dang thod pa dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ma hā su kha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'o/ rdo rje dril bu ma'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥswā hā/ zhes pa ni las thams cad pa'o// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su seng ge'i gdan lnga/ steng du sna tshogs pad nyi/ dbang ldan du glang po che/ mer rin po che bdun gyi phung po/ srin por ma he/ rlung du klu brgyad kyi mjug ma bsdus pa/ sgor sna tshogs pad+ma la ro'i snying kar nyi ma/ snying po'i gdugs dkar po dang bcas pa'i seng ge la gnas pa'i pad nyir/ ye shes dbang phyug ma sngon mo rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtsa phran can dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na steng du bstan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ dgra sta/ rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum na dril bu dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ ral gri bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ na bza' dmar po 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing rang bzhin gyi rdo rje sems dpa' la 'khyud pa/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo// byang du drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma ser mo// nub tu ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo// lhor gtum mo'i mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo// bzhi ka zhal gcig sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas steng du bsgreng ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ g.yon khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du seng ge ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ mer stag mo ma g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ srin por ce spyang ma g.yas dmar g.yon nag pa/ rlung du 'ug pa ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas rdo rje'i lcags kyu g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ shar sgor mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis khar bcug pa/ byang du 'bar byed ma ser mo mar me lta bu'i thal mo spyi bor 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'jib byed ma dmar mo snyim pa kha'i thad du bcas te khrag gi rgyun 'thung ba/

lhor skam bu dzi nag mo mthe bong gnyis sbyar mdzub mo brkyang bas rang gi bha gar bzhag nas gsang ba'i gnas ston pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa lha'i gos dmar po mnabs pa/ dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu'i 'od zer gyi tshogs kyis 'jigs par byed pa/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ snying po'i sngags so/ oṃ be dha li hūṃ swā hā/ las thams cad pa'o// // dgyes rdor mtshon cha can ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje'i mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/

phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la ro'i gdan/ de'i snying gar khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa'i steng du dgyes pa rdo rje 'jig rten gsum kun tu bskyod pa nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pas bdag med ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyug pa brdeg par gzas pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa lnga phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i smad dkris can/ zhabs g.yon gyi brlar g.yas pa'i sor mo brten pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ de'i shar gyi phyogs su rdo rje drag mo dkar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis gzhu dang byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa/ lhor gzugs ma ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mdung*// g.yon gnyis rdo rje'i zhags pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis chus gang ba'i thod pa dang dril bu/ byang du rdo rje zhi ba ma ljang khu phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis tal pa thung du dang ba dan rtse gsum pa g.yon gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gnod sbyin ma dkar ser phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis dbyug tho dang ut+pal/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang ḍā ma ru/ mer rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang me long*/ g.yon gnyis rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa dang dgra sta/ bden bral du sgra rdo rje ma sngo dmar phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis shak+ti dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/

rlung du sa'i rdo rje ma dkar ljang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis bdud rtsi lnga sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa mi lpags kyis g.yogs pa dang dril bu/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi dbang ldan gyi mtshams su gling bu ma dmar mo// mer pi wang ma ser mo/ bden bral du mu kun ta dkar mo/ rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can bzhi po sgeg pa'i nyams bag tsam gyis g.yo ba rang rang gi rol mo brdung pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha'i mdog sngon mo sngo nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams lcags kyu/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon rnams zhags pa/ sdigs mdzub/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams 'khor lo/ dril bu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams lcags sgrog rdo rje/ ral gri/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ma ljang khu ljang nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams dril bu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ gsum po'i g.yon rnams 'khor lo/ dril bu/ lcags kyu/ bzhi ka'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ thod pa la dung 'khor lo la sogs pas brgyan cing*/ stag sham can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa nyi ma'i 'od zer can sgo ba bzhi pad+ma thod pa nyi ma la bzhugs pa'o// gzhan rnams pad+ma dang thod pa zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rtsa ba'i phyag bzhi pa rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyi rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje phag mo la yang dag par 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma'i g.yon thod khrag rdo rjes mtshan pa dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyug pa brdeg par gzas pa/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje mda' dang rtse gsum/

g.yon pa gsum na dril bu gzhu dang thod pa/ dang po gnyis kyi yum lu gu rgyud ma la 'khyud pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa snga ma bzhin no// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar zla ba la sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ trai lo kya k+ṣe ba hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yo hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes so// dgyes rdor mtshon cha can phyag bcu drug pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ phung po'i bdud tshangs pa ser po/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud khyab 'jug nag po/ 'chi bdag gi bdud dbang phyug dkar po/ lha'i bu'i bdud brgya byin kham ser rnams kyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa'i rdo rje nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum steng ma dud kha rgyab zhal bzhi nag pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad na rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ thod pa/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum/ lcags kyu/ g.yon pa brgyad na dril bu/ pad+ma/ gzhu/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa/ rin po che/ sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa lnga phyag rgya drug dang mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i smad dkris can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ lhag ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ yum bdag med ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa'o// shar gyi 'dab mar gau rī dkar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na mda' phyung ba dang rdo rje gri gug g.yon pa gnyis na gzhu dang nya ro hi ta dang bcas pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lhor tsau rī ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang phag pa dang bcas pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu ro langs ma dkar ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang rus sbal dang bcas pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yon pa gnyis na chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang dri chus gang ba'i thod pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang ser zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na sbrul dang rkang mar gyis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i sbrul dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me thab dang dgra sta/

dbang ldan du puk+ka sī ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na shas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i seng ge dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yon gnyis dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dang rin po che/ mer sha wa rī dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod par gnas pa'i dge slong dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang zhags pa/ srin por tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i stag dang*/ pad dkar/ lhag ma gnyis rlung ras/ rlung du ḍom bi nī nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na chang gis gang ba'i thod pa dang rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gnyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i lce spyang dang gshol/ de dag gi phyi zur dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo/ mer pi wang ma ser mo/ bden bral du mu kun ta dkar mo/ rlung rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can bzhi po sgeg pa'i nyams bag tsam gyis g.yo ba rang rang gi rol mo brdung ba/ de dag thams cad skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo nag dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum khro la steng ma rta gdong ljang gu// phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na lcags kyu dang ral gri/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro la steng ma zhal dmar mo/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis 'khor lo dang dril bu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro la steng ma khyi gdong ser mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na lcags sgrog dang rdo rje/ ral gri/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro la steng ma seng gdong dmar mo// phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis na dril bu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ gsum ka'i g.yon 'khor lo/

dril bu/ lcags kyu/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa la gnas pa'i ro'i steng du g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'o// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ dā+e wa pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ oṃ swā hā/ las thams cad pa'o// // bdag med lha nyer gsum ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang*/ ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhir de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma/

rim pa nang ma'i shar nas g.yas su bskor ba'i 'dab mar rdo rje ma/ gau rī ma/ tsau rī ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rim pa phyi ma'i shar nas rim pa bzhin/ gau rī dkar ser/ tsau rī dmar ser/ ro langs ma dkar ser/ ghasma ri ljang ser/ byang shar nas g.yas su rim pa bzhin/ puk+ka sī ser mo/ sha wa rī dkar mo/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo/ ḍom bi nī nag mo/ steng gi shar ngos kyi pad+ma la mkha' spyod ma steng zhal can/ 'og gi nub ngos kyi pad+ma la sa spyod ma 'og zhal/ gtso mo sogs bdun sngon mo/ thams cad kyang khro ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang gri gug g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i snying khar gnas pa'i zla ba la bzhugs pa/ dbang ldan du gling bu ma dmar mo/ mer pi wang ma ser mo/ bden bral du mu kun ta dkar mo/ rlung du rdza rnga ma du ba'i mdog can bzhi po sgeg pa'i nyams bag tsam gyis g.yo ba/ rang rang gi rol mo brdung ba/ shar sgor rta gdong ma dkar sngo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser sngo/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar sngo/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang sngo/ ming dang rjes su mthun pa'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis nyi ma la gnas pa/ stag lpags dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i snying gar hūṃ sngon po de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥswā hā/

snying po/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ las thams cad pa'o// bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga ma ni// bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī// shar lhor sha wa rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ nub byang du ḍom bhi nī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad sku mdog nag mo/ khro ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i snying khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan g.yon par brten pa/ stag gis lpags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

gtso bo'i thugs kar baṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ sngags 'dra rig byed ma lha mo bco lnga ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ku ru kul+le dmar mo phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis ut+pal dmar po dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi dbu brgyan can/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi rol gyi 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha wa rī/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ nub byang du ḍom bhi nī/ steng du mkha' spyod ma/

'og tu sa spyod ma/ de thams cad dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ thams cad khro mo zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pas pad+ma dmar po dang ro'i snying gar gnas pa/ gtso mo'i snying gar hrīḥde las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ las thams cad pa 'dra// rdo rje bdud rtsi ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi ljang ser ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ 'od dmar po 'phro ba/ zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams can/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi gos can rdo rje sems dpa'i skyil krung gis zla ba la bzhugs pa/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis phyogs kyi 'dab mar zhi ba ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ zhi gdong ma ser mo ser nag dmar ba'i zhal/ zla ldan ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal/ ri bong can ljang khu ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ me nas g.yas bskor gyis mtshams su zla dkyil ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ zla tshes ma ljang ser ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ yid 'ongs ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ yid sim ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ thams cad phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi thabs dang*/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ral gri/ zla tshes ma/ chos kyi zla ba/ thams cad kyi g.yon gnyis zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ rim pa gnyis par dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor gyis me tog ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ bdug spos ma sngo skya sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ mar me ma gser mdog ser dkar nag pa'i zhal/ dri chab ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ thams cad phyag drug gi g.yas dang pos rim pa bzhin me tog gi za ma tog dang*/ spos phor dang*/ mar me'i mchod sdong dang*/ dri'i dung chos/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon rnams dril bu dang zhags pa dang*/ lcags kyu/ shar gyi snam bur gling bu ma dang*/ pi wang ma dang*/ mu kun ta ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma rnams rim pa bzhin dmar ser du ba sngo ba'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rang ming gi rol mo sgrog pa la brtson pa/ shar sgor khro gnyer rim par ldan sngon po nam mkha'i mdog can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal/

lho sgor 'jigs bsdigs dkar po 'jigs su rung ba dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal/ nub sgor rta'i gzugs dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal/ byang sgor tshogs kyi gtso bo ljang kha ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal/ thams cad 'gying ba khro bo'i stang stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas dang po rim pa bzhin lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon rnams dril bu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ lcags kyu/ lha nyi shu po thams cad bdud rtsi dang*/ po ti dang*/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che'i cod pan rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi gos can zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar haḥde las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ haḥbadz+ra a mṛ ta swā hā/ las thams cad pa yang de nyid do// bdud rtsi hūṃ mdzad ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/

de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gsang ba'i pad+ma bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal bdud rtsi hūṃ mdzad khro bo'i gzugs sku mdog sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum gyi rtsa zhal drag tu bzhad pa phyag drug gi dang po gnyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ de'i 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu/ lhag ma gnyis kyis kī li kī li ma dang rdo rje mtshon cha ma'i nu ma 'dzin pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam gyi cod pan/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gau rī dkar mo'i snying kar/ g.yon mnan pa'i rol pa'i zhabs/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyi phyogs bzhir/ rdo rje dregs ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje dang bdug spos dang gzhu/ g.yon gsum zhags pa 'khor lo mda' 'dzin pa/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gzhu dang*/ de'i 'og ma gnyis chu srin kyi rgyal mtshan/ lhag ma gnyis zhags pa rdo rje/ reg bya rdo rje ma sngo bsang sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis snying gar rdo rje/ de'i 'og ma gnyis gzhu dang mda'/ lhag ma gnyis rdo rje 'khor lo/ kī li kī li ma dmar mo dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum tsū ta'i snye ma dang mda' dang rdo rje/ g.yon gsum 'khor lo dang gzhu dang zhags pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i phyogs su gling bu ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gling bu 'bud pa'i tshul/ pi wang ma ser mo ser dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis pi wang brdung ba'i tshul/ mu kun ta ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis mu kun ta brdung ba'i tshul/

mu rañdza ma du ba'i mdog dud kha nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis mu rañdza brdung ba'i tshul/ mtshams dbang ldan nas g.yas su sgeg mo dmar mo dmar dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ phreng ba ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me tog gi phreng ba/ glu ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis 'khar rnga/ gar ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gar byed pa/ brgyad po'i 'og ma gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar du/ byams pa gser mdog zhal gcig mchog sbyin dang nā ga ge sar 'dzin pa/ 'jam dbyangs gser mdog mchog sbyin dang po ti can/ lhor nam mkha' snying po sngon po ral gri dang rin po che/ phyag rdor sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nub tu kun bzang gser mdog me tog g.yon dkur brten pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po mchod sbyin dang pad+ma/ byang du sgrib sel ser po g.yas dri ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon dkur brten pa/ sa snying ljang khu g.yas logs su thal sbyar/ dbang ldan nas rim pa bzhin dri ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis dri'i dung*/ me tog ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis me tog gi snod dang 'khor lo/ bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog dud kha dang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis bdug spos dang 'khor lo/ de gsum gyi 'og ma gnyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba/ gsum pa gnyis mda' gzhu/ mar me ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kong bu dang bcas pa'i thal sbyar/ de'i 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ lhag ma gnyis mda' gzhu/

shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dmar po dmar dkar ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum lcags kyu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum 'khor lo/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum zhags pa/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog ser po ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis lcags sgrog 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu/ lhag ma gnyis ral gri/ sdigs mdzub/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ljang khu ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum dril bu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje/ sdigs mdzub/ gzhu/ de bzhi khro bo'i gzugs can/ gzhan thams cad bdud rtsi glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i cod pan sna tshogs pa'i rin po ches brgyan pa/ zla ba la rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ sngags ni hūm̐ ngo*// bdud rtsi he ru ka ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/

bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun tu 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das he ru ka sngon po khro bo'i gzugs brnyan sngo dud kha ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa rtsa ba'i phyag dag gis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lhag ma'i g.yas rnams rgyu ma dang mgo bo dang rtse gsum/ g.yon rnams thod khrag dang srin po'i mgrin pa nas dpyangs pa dang*/ rus pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i cod pan can rgyu ma'i phreng bas phreng bar byas pa/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs can/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis gtsigs pa dang bcas pa ma ser mo ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ rdo rje dang mgo bo/ g.yon pa gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa/ rus 'phreng*/ gtsigs ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ rus phreng dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa dang mgo bo/ gtum mo sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang mgo bo/ g.yon pa gsum rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ g.yung mo du ba'i mdog dud ka dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ rus phreng dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ mgo bo dang thod pa/ dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor gyis/ drag mo sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ rgyu ma'i phreng ba dang rdo rje/

g.yon pa gsum kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang*/ thod pa dang mgo bo/ ser skya ma dmar mo dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na ral gri dang rgyu ma'i phreng ba dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang srin mgo rigs can ma nag mo nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ mgo bo dang rtse gsum g.yon pa gsum khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba/ drag mo ser mo ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri dang*/ rdo rje dang rus 'phreng*/ g.yon pa gsum khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang srin mgo rim pa gnyis pa'i shar nas bskor ba/ me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma nag mo/ mar me ma ser mo/ dri chab ma dmar mo/ mtshams su gling bu ma ser mo/ pi wang ma dmar mo/ mu kun ta ma dkar mo/ mu rañdza ma du ba'i mdog can/ g.yas rnams kyis rang rang gi ming can gyis mchod pa/ g.yon rnams rdo rje 'dzin cing khaṭ+wāṃ ga de'i gru khugs su brten pa/ shar sgor ba lang gi rna ba dkar po/ lho sgor glang po che'i rna ba dmar po/ nub sgor bzhin bzang ser po/ byang sgor bzhin ngan dud kha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rim pa bzhin lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang drag cing sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ rdo rje dang gtsug gi nor bu'i cod pan can 'od dmar po glu len pa dang gar byed pa'i tshul can thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar haḥ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag cing*/ slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭ bh+yo swā hā// rdo rje bdud rtsi nag po ni/

bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du// phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas la 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan la dpal rdo rje bdud rtsi nag po khro bo chen po'i gzugs can nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum dgra sta dang*/ rdo dang ral gri/ g.yon pa gsum sdigs mdzub dang*/ gtun shing dang zhags pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ spyan ser skya 'bar ba'i sma ra ser po/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam gyis mtshan pa/ lus thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ shar nas rim pa bzhin bdud rtsi ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang*/ bdud rtsi'i snod dang rdo rje/ bdud rtsi'i zhal ma sngo bsangs sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang*/ gdong gis mtshan pa'i me long dang dgra sta/ g.yon zhags pa dang gtun shing dang sdigs mdzub/ bdud rtsi'i lus ma sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs yod pa dang*/

ral gri/ bdud rtsi spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang mig gis mtshan pa'i zla ba dang ral gri/ dbang ldan nas rim pa bzhin/ bde sgrub ma dmar mo dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rdo rje/ dpag med ma sngo bsangs sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum pad+ma dang ral gri dang gtun shing*/ gzugs mdzes ma gser mdog ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang ral gri/ sna bzang ma ser skya ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang ral gri/ lhag ma rnams kyi g.yon gsum dgra sta dang*/ zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub/ thams cad kyang rdo rje gtsug gi nor bu 'dzin cing gar byed pa'i tshul can/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum lcags kyu dang rdo rje dang ral gri/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum zhags pa dang*/ ral gri dang rdo rje/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum lcags sgrog dang*/ ral gri dang rdo rje/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ljang khu ljang nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum dril bu dang*/ rdo rje dang ral gri/ bzhi ka'i g.yon gsum gtun shing dang dgra sta dang sdigs mdzub/ mche ba cher gtsigs pa 'bar ba'i sma ra ser po rdo rje bdud rtsi'i glegs bam cod pan du byas pa/ khros pa'i sku can sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa/ 'od dmar po 'phro ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar sa bon/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/

khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li āḥmaṃ swā hā/ snying po'o/ dgyes rdor thod pa can gyi snying po kyai rdo rje ni/ rgyas par spro na 'jam pa'i rdo rje lta bu'i bsrung 'khor ram/ bsdus na bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/

gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha// drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud ka bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po// brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyi tshul gyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po lha dbang ste bdud rnam pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi snying ga mnan pa'i nyi ma la/ de'i yum bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mig mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ lag gdub/ ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon ro hi ta'i nya bsnams pa/ lho tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ nub tu bai ta lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal/

g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ byang du ghas ma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon rnal 'byor lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshams bzhir puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta bsnams pa/ sha wa rī dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed bsnams pa/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ ḍoṃ bhi ṇī zhal ras dkar bar/ thugs ka nag pa/ lte ba dmar ba/ 'doms dkar ba/ brla dang dpung pa ser ba/ lag ngar gnyis dang rkang pa'i rje ngar ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis rim pa bzhin tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag po gshin rje lus ngan srin po thags bzang ris kyi snying kar zla ba'i steng me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal ga cig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dpung par brten pa'i g.yon pa'i phyag gis thod pa gzung zhing bdag med ma la 'khyud pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbu la mgo bo skam po lngas brgyan cing rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ smin ma 'khyog po dang bcas pa'i khro gnyer can/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ro'i snying kar nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pas gar mdzad pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rtsa ba'i phyag rdo rje 'phyar zhing thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje phag mo la 'khyud pa/ mi bskyod pa'i/

bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku mdog nag po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang gri gug g.yon gnyis dril bu dang rtse gsum/ lhag ma dag gis rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma nag mo gri gug dang thod pa can la 'khyud pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pa'i gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ 'di bzhi po'i sngags sngar bzhin no/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma hā mā yā sku mdog sngon po sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ka pā la dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/

rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thal chen gyis byugs pa/ thod skam gyi cod pan dang mgo rlon gyi do shal/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'i lpags pa bgos te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar can/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang ka pā la/ g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa /lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang tri shu la/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan dang lce spyang gi mgrin pa dam du 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dkar mo dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na sna tshogs pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang gzhu/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ljang mo ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal can phyag bzhi pa g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pa gnyis na zhags pa dang ka pā la/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang mtshan dang dpe byad du ldan pa/ gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu brgyan thod rlon gyi do shal phyag rgya lngas brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis 'od zer 'phreng ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rigs kyi bdag pos mdzes pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ snying po oṃ haṃ hūṃ/ las thams cad pa'o/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ni/

bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis sa gzhi /de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda' drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i ro gdan la/ he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum po/ hūṃ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza'/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i 'phreng ba 'chang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lngas brgyan can/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba byed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ 'od kyi phreng ba 'khrug pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyis phyogs kyi 'dab mar sna tshogs bde ma dang*/ 'dod ma dang*/ 'og na gnas ma dang*/ legs bzang mo rnams dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor gyis mtshams gyi 'dab mar chang 'tshong ma dang*/ 'byung mo dang*/ phyag bzhi ma dang*/ nam mkha' la gnas ma rnams dmar mo zhal gcig mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis gri gug dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma ru'i snod/

gos ser can 'od 'phro ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa lnga'i cod pan/ mgo bo'i do shal phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yang na he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sngon po/ phyogs ma sngon mo dang*/ mtshams ma ser mo/ yum med pa'am 'og nas 'chad pa bzhin gyi yum dang bcas pa gdam nga'o/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ bhu dha ka pā li a hrī he hūṃ phaṭ/ snying po// las thams cad pa yang de ka'o// rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng du/
