'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i bcom ldan 'das bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bu'i 'od zer 'bar zhing khro la gtum pa/ ma lus pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs zhal du gsol ba/ sku mdog sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal mi sdug pa gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma g.yo ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu mgul nas 'phyang ba klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas lcags kyu zhags pa/ g.yon thod pa khaṭ+wāṃ/ g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ shar du rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi dang po rdo rje tho ba dang*/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi dang po dbyug pa/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar mo dmar dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi dang po pad+ma dmar po/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po sna tshogs rdo rje/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin du ba'i mdog dud kha dang ser ljang pa'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po lcags kyu/ srin por rdo rje dus mtshan dmar po dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po dgra sta/ rlung du nag po chen po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po tri shu la 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba nag mo nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po ral gri/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po 'khor lo/ de thams cad kyi lhag ma'i phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/

g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po rdo rje gtun shing dang*/ gnyis pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon gnyis klu'i zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas khaṭ+wāṃ ga thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mi sdug par gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril pa/ 'jigs su rung ba// zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma g.yo ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'i 'phreng ba dang khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu mgul nas 'phyang ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing nyi ma la phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng tshangs pa/ 'og thag bzang ris brdzis te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dh+ṝka badz+ra hūṃ kā ra/ snying po/ las thams cad pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūṃ phaṭ/ yang na shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po zhes nas 'khyud pa g.yas brkyang gis pad+ma nyi mar bzhugs pa/ zhes gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa bzhin no// yang na shar du gshin rje mthar byed nag po thams cad g.yon brkyang gis pad+ma nyi mar bzhugs pa zhes 'jam rdor bzhin no// yang na gshin rje mthar byed phyag g.yas pa gsum nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa zhes pa'i bar kha sbyor rdor sems bzhin/ 'di gsum las thams cad pa'i sngags/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭ/

'khor lo sdom pa drug cu rtsa gnyis pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du ri rab kyi steng gi sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/

'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa ni gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na khaṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ thod pa dum bu'i ska rags can/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pa yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/

mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon bskor du// dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum mo/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang*/ sna chen ma/ me nas g.yas skor gyi lha dgra dang*/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi thung ma/ rdo rje 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rjes lus dang shing grib ma rnams sngon mo// rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs las/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo// dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bzang mo// rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo// 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma thams cad dmar mo/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang bzhin bzang mo// pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo thams cad dkar mo// dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba/ yum rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba/

phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo// lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ bde mchog phyag gnyis pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje'i mda'i drwa ba nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du ri rab kyi steng gi sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma'i phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gcer mo skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pa yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon yab dang lhan cig tu brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o/

thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon bskor du/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ dpa' mo rab gtum mo/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me nas g.yas bskor gyis/ lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi thung ma/ rdo rje 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma rnams sngon mo/ rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma thams cad dmar mo/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang shin tu bzang mo/ pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen mo// rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo thams cad dkar mo/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' bo rnams rdo rje dang dril bu/ dpa' mo rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum ma gcer mo skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/

rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ bde chen dang dam tshig gi lha mo rnams phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa de'i gru mo la brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ bde mchog ser po ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ ri rab kyi steng gi sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/

de'i phyir pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa gru mo'i ngos la khaṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ mi mgo skam po lngas brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyis nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gcer bu skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pa yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon pa yab dang lhan cig brkyang ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du lā ma/ nub tu duṃ skyes ma/ lho ru gzugs can ma thams cad ser mo// g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon thod pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon bskor du/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/

me nas g.yas bskor gyis/ lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi thung ma/ rdo rje 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma/ dpa' bo rnams nag po rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpa' mo dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo// dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma/ dpa' bo rnams dmar po pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pas dpa' mo nag mo g.yas pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang shin tu bzang mo// pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo// dpa' bo rnams dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' mo rnams dmar mo g.yas 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar sgor kha gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo// lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo rnams g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug lha mo thams cad kyi g.yon thod pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba mo g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/

g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i mi mgo 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu gnyis gru mo'i ngos la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje 'phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can no// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūṃ/ de las bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas/ gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ las thams cad pa'o// phag mo gsum ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyi khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/

de'i dbus su gri gug gi 'phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma'i phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i 'od ltar 'bar ba/ khro ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar ba/ rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i khaṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ g.yon bskor du dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma/ 'tshams me nas g.yas bskor du/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ mi thung ma/ laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma rnams sngon mo/ rim pa de nyid kyi gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ sa srung ma/ 'jigs byed chen mo// rlung gi shugs can ma/ chang 'thung ma/ mtshams la lha mo sngo bsangs ma/ rab tu bzang mo/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma rnams dmar mo/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ dum skyes ma/ chang 'tshong ma/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la shin tu bzang mo/ stobs chen ma/ 'khor los sgyur ma/ brtson 'grus chen mo rnams dkar mo// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/

byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo/ g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can ma rnams su gyur/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso mo'i thugs kar baṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po'o/ las thams cad pa gong bzhin no/ phag mo sngon mo ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/

bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i 'phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma'i 'phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i 'phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i 'od ltar 'bar ba/ khro ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar ba/ rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod par byed pa// g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod pan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i khaṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo// byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// g.yon bskor du dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma/ mtshams me nas g.yas bskor du/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ mi thung ma/ laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma rnams sngon mo// rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/

sa srung ma/ 'jigs byed chen mo/ rlung gi shugs can ma/ chang 'thung ma/ mtshams la/ lha mo sngo bsangs ma/ rab tu bzang mo/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma rnams dmar mo/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ dum skyes ma/ chang 'tshong ma/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la shin tu bzang mo/ stobs chen ma/ 'khor los sgyur ma/ brtson 'grus chen mo rnams dkar mo/ shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo// lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum ma gcer mo skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ bde chen dang dam tshig gi lha mo rnams phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa de'i gru mo la brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer mo skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs gyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso mo'i thugs kar bam̐/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ sngags 'dra/ phag mo ser mo ni/

bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang*/ nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i phreng ba can gyi thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ de'i phyir pad+ma'i phreng ba can gyi gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo'i phreng ba can gyi sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad yod pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ khro ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phyar ba/ rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus pa gcod par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i ros tshim par mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ thal chen spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa gcer bu brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ g.yon bskor du dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma/ mtshams me nas g.yas bskor du/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ mi thung ma/ laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma rnams dkar mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ sa srung ma/ 'jigs byed chen mo// rlung gi shugs can ma/ chang 'thung ma/ mtshams la sngo bsangs ma/ rab tu bzang mo/ rta rna ma// bya gdong ma rnams nag mo g.yas pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ dum skyes ma/ chang 'tshong ma/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la shin tu bzang mo/ stobs chen ma/ 'khor los sgyur ma/ brtson 'grus chen mo rnams dmar mo g.yas 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar sgor khā gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo rnams g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug lha mo thams cad kyi g.yon thod pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ g.yas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i mi mgo 'dzin pa/ lha mo bcu gnyis gru mo'i ngos la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can no// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/

gtso mo'i thugs kar baṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭ/ snying po/ las thams cad gong bzhin no// sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas/ 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nag po la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad ma 'dab brgyad pa/ de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dmar po/ rtsibs mchan ljang khu/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad dkar po/ rtsibs mchan nag po rim pa bzhin gsum po mu khyud rdo rje sngon po dang pad dmar dang rdo rje dkar pos byas pa/ lte ba'i dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid kyi ro/ de'i steng du he ru ka sangs rgyas thod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug

g.yon na thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ hūm̐ zhes sgrog cing skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa 'jigs shing khro ba'i bdag nyid stag gi pags pa'i na bza' mnabs pa/ mgo rlon bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i phreng ba 'chang zhing*/ phyag rgya drug dang dpral ba'i steng du sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor cog nag po can/ gtso bo'i shes rab chen mo sna tshogs bde ma dmar mo zhal shin tu 'gyur ma/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pas 'jigs pa/ g.yas na ḍā ma ru 'chang zhing gri gug brdeg pa'i tshul/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba'i rgyun 'dzag pa yab la stob cing khaṭ+wāṃ ga gru mo la gzer ba/ gcer bu rgyan dang bral ba/ skra grol ba skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis yab dang 'khril ba/ gnyis ka 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ nang ma'i shar nas g.yon bskor gyis rtsibs nas 'phreng bzang ma/ byang du 'od can ma/ nub tu 'jigs ma/ lhor thub dka' ma/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyi gzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i rtsibs la dge ba'i ska rags ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang*/ rnam rgyal ma dang*/ byed ma phyogs la/ thod pa can dang*/ mtsho chen ma dang*/ rgyud byed ma dang*/ gsod byed ma mtshams la/ sku'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs la/ sgrol byed ma dang*/ 'jigs ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ mi pham ma rnams phyogs la/ dge ma dang*/ 'jur byed ma dang*/ dus mtshams ma dang*/ grags chen ma rnams mtshams/ de thams cad nyi ma la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ shar sgor mdzes ma/ byang sgor 'dzin ma/ nub sgor skal bzang ma/ lho sgor grags mthong ma/ nyi ma dang ro'i steng du g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ lha mo sku mdog nag mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ stag gi pags pas rked pa dkris shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

'od zer rnon po gtibs pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ kha nas khrag 'thor ba/ khu ba dang ldan pa thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ bud dha ka pā li ni a hri haiḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ snying po'o/ las thams cad pa yang de'o// gdan bzhi ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ rlung dang me dang chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgya mtsho chen po la sogs pas bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ de'i dbus su rta babs med pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi'i nang re mig dgu pa phyi rol tu rdo rje 'phreng ba nang dang*/ phyi rim pa lngas bskor ba'i zlum po/

dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la seng ge'i gdan pad nyi'i steng du gdugs dkar po dang ldan pa/ re mig gi shar du glang po/ byang du rma bya/ nub tu khyung*/ lhor kiṅka ra/ dbang ldan du seng ge mer rdo rje phag mchu/ bden bral du ma he/ rlung du spyang ki sgo bzhir ro// gzhan lha gnas thams cad du pad zla/ dbus su rnal 'byor nam mkha'/ sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba// g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum zlum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtse phran can dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul la sogs pa'i brgyan/ na bza' dmar po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad bsnyil ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis shes rab kyi nu ma dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis seng ge'i steng sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ de'i pang du yum ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo shin tu mdzes pa khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing ma mchu tshems kyis 'debs pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis sku bcings shing rdo rje pad+mar thim pa/ lha mo'i rgyan thams cad dang mdzes pa'i gos can/ shar du glang po che'i rgyal po la rol pas gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ nub tu bya khyung la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ lhor kiṅka ra'i gdan la pus mo'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtum mo mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/

dbu skra sbram pa grol zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lha mo bzhi ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags pas smad/ mi'i zhing gis stod g.yogs pa/ dbang ldan du seng ge la rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ mer rdo rje phag mchu la zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i stag mo g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ srin por ma he la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i lce spyang ma g.yas dmar g.yon nag pa/ g.yas dgra sta 'phyar ba/ rlung du ce spyang la tsog pu'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i 'ug pa ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thams cad thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar gyi sgo ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang gi mar me ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ nub kyi 'jib byed ma dmar mo snyim pa khrag gis gang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lho'i skam bu dzi nag mo thugs kar gtun shing 'dzin pa/ phyi'i zlum po'i shar du puk+ka sī dang*/ khro gnyer ma dang*/ gtum mo rnams dkar mo phyag na bdud rtsi'i snod/ byang du drag mo dang*/ khrag 'thung ma dang*/ sha za ma rnams ser mo phyag na sha lngas gang ba'i pad+ma'i snod/ nub tu khro mo dang 'bar ma dang*/ 'jigs byed ma rnams dmar mo phyag na gtor snod/ lhor thod 'phreng ma dang*/ rdo rje ma dang*/ bum pa ma rnams nag mo phyag na dam tshig gi zas dang btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ grwa bzhi'i dbang ldan du sgeg mo snyems pa'i phyag rgya can dang dri chab ma dri'i snod ser mo/ mer pi waṃ ma pi waṃ bsgreng ba dang*/ me tog ma me tog 'thor pa dkar mo/ bden bral du glu ma kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yo ba dang*/ bdug spos ma spos phor nag mo/ rlung du gar ma gar gyi tshul du steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang*/

mar me ma mar me bsgreng ba dmar mo/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum ma dbu skra grol ba thod pa lngas brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi snam bu'i shar la keng rus 'jigs byed dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga'i srin po dang tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dkar po/ byang du gtum mo'i dbang phyug dang*/ 'dun pa'i lha dang*/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba rnams ser po/ nub tu 'dod pa'i drag po dang*/ ṣa ṇa ḍi la'i dbang phyug dang*/ ḍā ma ru'i 'dul byed dang*/ rnga sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po/ lhor taṃ bu ra'i dbang phyug dang*/ s+tha ra ṇa dang*/ mche ba gtsigs pa dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa rnams chung ma dang bcas pa/ shar gyi sgo ba khyab 'jug nag po/ byang gi sgo ba tshangs pa dmar po/ nub kyi sgo ba lha chen dkar po/ lho'i sgo ba brgya byin ser po/ grwa'i dbang ldan du dbang po ser po/ mer nor lta ku be ra ser skya/ srin por 'byung po'i bdag po gshin rje nag po/ rlung du chu lha wa ru ṇa dkar po rnams chung ma dang bcas pa/ de thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ dang rtse gsum g.yon yum la 'khyud pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can thod 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa stag gi sham thabs can/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hūm̐/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ ha swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ ghuṃ ghā swā hā/ ro langs ma'i las thams cad pa'o// dgra nag ni/

bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal mi sdug par gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma g.yo ba khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu mgul nas 'phyang ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ spom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ phyag drug gi rtsa ba'i phyag gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ lhag ma gnyis ral gri dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ pad nyi'i steng du ma he nag po khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rgyab tu pad nyi gshin rje'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i gdong phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma/

lhor nga rgyal gshin rje gshed ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i gdong phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ mer tsartsi ka ma keṃ po dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma/ bden bral du phag mo rtsa ba phag gdong ser po g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma/ rlung du rdo rje dbyangs can ma dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ dbang ldan du dkar mo ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po dkar dmar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rdo rje tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis rdo rje dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo/ nub sgor pad+ma'i gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i gdong*/ phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang sgor ral gri'i gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i gdong phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma/ thams cad kyang zhal mi sdug pa gdangs pa/ mtshe ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril pa/

'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma g.yo ba khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'i phreng ba dang khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu mgul nas 'phyang ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba/ yan lag rags pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi shes rab ma dang*/ lha mo rnams rang 'dra ba'i thabs la 'khyud pa/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dang lha mo rnams pad zla/ gzhan rnams pad nyi la gnas pa/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar yaṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur// oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ las thams cad pa yang de'o// rdo rje sgrol ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/

de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la bcom ldan 'das sgrol ma gser btso ma lta bu ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma g.yas rnams rdo rje zhags pa/ mda'/ dung*/ g.yon rnams ut+pal ser po/ gzhu/ lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub/ rin 'byung gi cod pan can/ shar gyi 'dab mar me tog sgrol ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis me tog gi phreng ba/ lhor bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos/ nub tu mar me sgrol ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis mar me/ byang du dri'i sgrol ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung phor/ de dag zla ba la gnas pa/ grwa nang ma'i me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sangs rgyas bzhi'i rang bzhin 'khor lo dkar po/ rdo rje sngon po/ pad+ma dmar po/ ral gri ljang khu/ sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrogs ma dmar mo lcags sgrog rdo rjes mtshan pa/ rdo rje dril bu ma rdo rje'i dril bu/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma la yum bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi bum pa dang*/ ri rab dang*/ me thab dang*/ rgyal mtshan chen po/ steng du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon mo klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ de dag gi g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub/ thams cad kyang gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba/ sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing pad+ma rā ga'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i thugs kar trāṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag

slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ las thams cad pa yang de'o// 'od zer can ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te/ 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyi khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su mchod rten gyi phug gi dkyil du sna tshogs pad zla la bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma ser mo ser dkar ba'i zhal gnyis khro ba/ g.yon phag gdong khro gnyer dang spyan zur mig tu ldan pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang rin po ches brgyan pa zur phud la mchod rten gyis mdzes pa/ gos sngon po gyon zhing phag ser po'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa phag ser pos bskor ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum mda' dang rdo rje khab/ g.yon rnams kyis gzhu/ skud pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing me tog dang bcas pa'i yal ga rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ shar phyogs su karka ma si dang*/ mer ut+ta ma si gnyis/ dmar mo khab skud/ lhor ka ma si dang bden bral du gul mi si gnyis ser mo skud pa dang bcas pa'i khab dang*/

mya ngan med pa'i yal ga nub tu at+ta ra dha ma si dang*/ rlung du ba dan ma si gnyis dmar mo mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang*/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ byang du te dzo ma si dang*/ dbang ldan du tsi bar ma si gnyis dmar mo mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ shar gyi snam bu la ma hā bar ma si dang*/ bar ha lu khi ni nag mo mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung ba dang rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lhor pa ḍā kra ma si dang ba ra le ser mo mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang rdo rje/ nub tu par kra ma si dang ba da le dmar mo mda' gzhu/ byang du ut+ma ma si dang*/ ba ra li ljang khu khab dang skud pa/ mer pa dha li dmar mo khab dang skud pa/ bden bral du ba ra li ser mo skud bcas kyi khab dang mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi chun po/ rlung du ba ra li dkar mo mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang zhags pa/ dbang ldan du wa ra ha lu mu khi dmar mo gzhu dang mda'/ shar la sogs pa'i sgor a lo dang tā lo dang sad tsha lo dang saṃ ba muta dha ḍi rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa/ de dag thams cad gsar pa'i lang tsho can zhal gcig ma phag gdong khro gnyer dang spyan zur mig du ldan pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mya ngan med pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang rin po ches brgyan pa zur pud la mchod rten gyis mdzes pa gos sngon po gyon zhing phag ser po'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ sgo skyong ma rnams g.yas brkyang ba'i pad nyi'o// gtso mo'i thugs kar māṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai swā hā/

snying po/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai hūm̐sarba bhigh+nān ut+pa da ya hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ las thams cad pa'o/ gzungs grwa lnga ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad zla la bcom ldan 'das so sor 'brang ma chen mo ser mo ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas rnams rin po che'i pa tra 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ mda'/ ral gri/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon rnams kyis rdo rje/ zhags pa/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ dgra sta/ dung*/ dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shar phyogs su sna tshogs pad zla la stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dkar mo dkar sngo ser ljang pa'i zhal bzhi phyag bcu pa g.yas rnams kyis pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ mchog sbyin/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams kyis rdo rje sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ dgra sta/ 'od zer dkar po rol pas bzhugs pa/ lhor sna tshogs pad nyi la gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma chen mo nag mo nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis kyi bcu gnyis pa dang g.yas pa'i gnyis pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/

gzhan gnyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas pa'i lhag rdo rje/ mda'/ mchog sbyin mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ g.yon rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ rin po che'i pa tra/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i bum pa nyi ma'i 'od can rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ nub tu sna tshogs pad+mar bsil ba'i tshal chen mo dmar mo dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad kyis g.yas rnams pad+ma dang bcas pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mda'/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ rin po che snying kar gnas pa'i po ti nyi ma'i 'od can skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ byang du sna tshogs pad zla la rma bya chen mo ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rma bya'i mjug sgro dang mda' dang mchog sbyin/ ral gri g.yon rnams lhung bzed na gnas pa'i dge slong gzhu pang du gnas pa'i bum pa rin po che 'bar ba 'bab pa sna tshogs rdo rje can rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ lha snam gyi me nas mtshams su nag mo nag mo dung 'dzin pa/ dus mtshan ma ser mo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rnam nag mo dmar mo dgra sta/ dkar mo dkar mo rtse gsum/ gtso 'khor de thams cad kyang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gos con pan can zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad nyi la rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu/ dkar ser dmar ljang rang ming gi phyag mtshan can/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ 'di lnga yang gtso bo'i gnas su gang 'dod pa de dang de'i gnas su bzhag pas bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor lnga'o// gtso mo'i thugs kar praṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag

slar sdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pa ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ buṃ// oṃ āḥmahā sa ha sra pra mar+dha ni buṃ hūm̐hūm̐'um̐/ oṃ āḥm hā man+t+ra a nu pa ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐'u/ dz+riṃ/ oṃ āḥmahā shī ta bti badz+ra hūm̐/ maṃ/ oṃ ma hā ma yu ri bid+yā rā dzñi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rdo rje dbyings ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ gling dang nye ba'i gling phran rgya mtsho bdun la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyi khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gzhal yas khang lnga tshom gyi dbus mar seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dkar po dkar ser dmar ljang zhi ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ 'og ma gnyis kyi bsam gtan dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang gzhu/ nyi ma'i 'od can sangs rgyas lngas spras pa'i rin po che'i cod pan gyis mdzes pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang gos dang ldan pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

rang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas gdab pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la sems ma rdo rje ma sngon mo rdo rje rtse lnga dmar po dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ lhor rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo rdo rje rtse lngas rtse mor mtshan pa'i rin po che/ sdigs mdzub/ nub tu chos kyi rdo rje ma dmar mo rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa'i 'dab brgyad dkar dmar dang pad+ma/ byang du las kyi rdo rje ma ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa kha dog lnga pa dang sdigs mdzub/ shar gyi dkyil 'khor du glang po che'i steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos rdo rje rtse lnga sngon po bzung nas sa gnon mnyam bzhag de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas pa'i gung mos snying kar 'gying ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje gsor pa/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur bsnyems pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lhor rdo rje rgyal po ser po phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis bcings pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa/ byang du rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu/ nub tu rdo rje legs pa ljang khu/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis snying kar legs par 'byin pa'i tshul/ lhor rta'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che bzung nas mchog sbyin gyi tshul/ g.yon mnyam bzhag de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rin chen rdo rje ser po g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtha' gnyis la rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i 'phreng ba bzung nas rang rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'ching bar byed cing*/ g.yon rdo rje dril bu snyems pas dkur brten pa/ lhor rdo rje gzi brjid dmar po snying kar phyag gnyis kyi nyi ma/

byang du rdo rje tog ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis g.yon gyi bar lhur gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub tu bzhad pa dkar po phyag gnyis so'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i khar bzhag pa/ nub tu rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bzung nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya bcas pa/ de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje chos dmar skya g.yon 'gying ba'i tshul gyis pad+ma'i yu ba nas bzung zhing*/ g.yas pas de kha 'byed pa/ lhor rdo rje rnon po nam mkha'i mdog can g.yon pa thugs kar sher phyin gyi po ti/ g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul/ byang du rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yon pa'i gung mos 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ nub tu rdo rje gsung ba dmar po chos kyi dung dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rtse 'dzin pa/ byang du khyung gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar don yod grub pa ljang khu rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos sna tshogs rdo rje bzung nas mi 'jigs pa'i tshul/ g.yon mnyam bzhag de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje las ljang khu g.yas snying kar bslang ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa dang*/ g.yon sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ lho ru rdo rje bsrung ba ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje'i go cha/ byang du rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mthe'u chung gnyis kyis rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon gyi rtse mo rang gi khar bcug pas bdud rnams bsdigs par byed pa/ nub tu rdo rje khu tshur ser po khu tshur gyis bzung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gi me'i pad+ma la rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo dkur brten pa'i phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje re re/

bden bral du pad+ma la 'phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis rin po che'i phreng ba/ rlung du pad+ma la glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang gi rgyud sbreng ba/ dbang ldan du pad+ma la gar ma ljang khu rtse gsum pa gnyis bzung nas phyag gnyis gar mdzad pa/ phyi ma'i snam bu shar gyi pad+ma la byams pa dang*/ don yod grub pa dang*/ ngan song kun 'dren dang*/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros rnams sngon po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos rdo rje rtse lnga bzung nas sa gnon mnyam bzhag lho'i pad+ma la spos kyi glang po dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod dang*/ ye shes tog rnams rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che gzung nas mchog sbyin gyi tshul/ nub kyi pad+ma la 'od dpag med dang*/ zla ba'i 'od dang bzang skyong dang*/ drwa ba can gyi 'od rnams rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma bzung nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya bcas pa/ byang gi pad+ma la rdo rje snying po dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa dang*/ spobs pa mi zad pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po rnams rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbu brgyan pa/ g.yas kyi gung mos sna tshogs rdo rje bzung nas mi 'jigs pa'i tshul/ me'i pad+ma la rdo rje bdug spos ma dkar mo/ srin po'i pad+ma la rdo rje me tog ma ser mo/ rlung gi pad+ma la rdo rje mar me ma dkar dmar/ dbang ldan gyi pad+ma la rdo rje dri chab ma ljang khu/ ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan/ shar sgo la sogs pa'i pad+ma la rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrogs/ rdo rje 'bebs pa rnams rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang rang ming gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa/

gtso 'khor thams cad nyi ma'i 'od zer can/ gos dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa rin po che'i cod pan can/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs bcu drug ma gtogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mngon par phyogs pa/ sems dpa' bcu drug ni rang rang gi de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa/ thams cad kyang zla ba la sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yang na gtso bo dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang bcas pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gzhan 'dra/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi snam bu la byams pa sogs bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong du bzhi ma tshang ba 'god pa 'dam ka'o// thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar āḥde las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā yo gi shwa ra hūṃ/ snying po/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags las thams cad pa'o// 'jam rdor lha zhe gsum ma ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid ro gcig tu nges par byas te/ 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/

bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje tho ba nag po dang ral gri/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dbyug pa dkar po dang nag po/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis pad+ma dmar po dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje dang ral gri/ mer 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang ral gri/ bden bral du dbyug sngon can nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis dbyug ba sngon po dang ral gri/ rlung du stobs po che nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rtse gsum dang ral gri/ dbang ldan du mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis 'khor lo ser po dang ral gri/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rang 'od kyi rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor can/ 'dod rgyal/ mi g.yo ba/ gnod mdzes rnams rin po che'i rgyan can 'gying ba mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/

lhag ma rnams mi sdug pa'i gzugs can zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra ser po/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku bongs thung zhing yan lag rags pa/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan can/ nyi ma'i 'od can rang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i sku dpag tu med pas khams gsum mtha' yas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rlag par byed pa/ g.yon brkyang gis rtsibs kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i pad nyi la gnas pa/ 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i lte bar mchod rten dkar po'i nang du phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su gzhal yas khang nyis sbrag de'i nang ma'i seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba la bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin 'jam pa'i rdo rje sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum ral gri/ mchog sbyin/ mda'/ g.yon pa gsum sher phyin gyi po ti dang chu skyes sngon po gzhu/ me tog sna tshogs dkris pa'i gtsug phud gsum lha'i gos dang rgyan thams cad kyis klubs pa/ blta na sdug pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bdag lta bu'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la snyoms par 'jug pa/ shar phyogs kyi ling tsher glang po che'i steng du pad nyi la mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang po'i gung mos snying kar rdo rje gyen du bsgreng zhing*/ g.yon dang pos rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis nu ma dang zhags pa gzhu 'dzin pa 'gying ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa/ lhor rta'i steng gi pad nyi la rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag

lhag ma'i g.yas rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon nu ma dang rdo rje/ nub tu rma bya'i steng gi pad nyir snang ba mtha' yas dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang po sgeg pa dang bcas pas pad+ma'i yu ba snying kar gzung ste g.yas dang pos de kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis nu ma dang spyi blugs/ byang du bya khyung gi steng gi pad nyir don yod grub pa dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis nu ma dang lcags kyu/ bzhi ka'ang bdag lta bu'i shes rab ma la snyoms par 'jug pa/ dbang ldan du spyan ma ser mo ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad/ g.yon rnams kyi sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang rin po che'i snye ma dang*/ bgrang 'phreng dang gzhu/ mer mā ma ki sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro ba dang bcas pas rgod pa/ phyag drug gi g.yon pa rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ bden bral du gos dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon rnams kyis pad+ma dang bgrang 'phreng dang gzhu/ rlung du sgrol ma ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dang*/ ut+pal dang gzhu/ spyan ma g.yas dang po mchog sbyin/ lhag ma gsum dang gzhan thams cad kyi g.yas mi 'jigs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mda'/ de'i rim pa gnyis pa'i shar nas brtsams pa'i phyogs la sems ma rdo rje ma sngon mo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang po'i gung mos snying kar rdo rje gyen du bsgreng zhing g.yon dang pos rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis sdigs mdzub dang zhags pa gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin chen rdo rje ma ser mo ser dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis mnyam bzhag

lhag ma'i g.yas rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje ma dkar mo dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon dang po sgeg pa dang bcas pas pad+ma'i yu ba snying kar bzung ste g.yas dang pos de kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang rdo rje/ g.yon pa gnyis zhags pa dang spyi blugs/ las kyi rdo rje ma dmar mo dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub dang lcags kyu/ dbang ldan du tsun dā dkar mo rtsa zhal dang g.yas zhal sngo ba ljags 'gul zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ g.yon ser po ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug ma/ dang po gnyis snying kar rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas rnams ral gri/ mi 'jigs pa/ rin chen phreng*/ bi dza pū ra/ mda'/ dgra sta/ mdung thung*/ tho ba/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ba dan gsum gyi tshul dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon rnams yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ pad+ma/ spyi blugs/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ shak+ti/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ sdigs mdzub/ bum pa bzang po/ bi dī pa la sher phyin gyi po ti/ kan dzu ka'i stod g.yogs bcings shing bla gos phrag par gzar ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu'i rang bzhin can/ mer rin chen skar mda' ser mo phyag drug gi dang po gnyis snying kar rin po che kha sbyor 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis sdigs mdzub dang gzhu/ bden bral du khro gnyer can dkar mo phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ mda'/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub/ spyi blugs/ gzhu/ rlung du rdo rje lcags sgrog ma ljang khu phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ mda'/ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ de thams cad rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pa dang ldan la zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs shing 'od dmar po 'phro ba/

rim pa gsum pa'i shar du byams pa gser mdog phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ g.yas 'og ma mchog sbyin g.yon me tog dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi yal ga 'jam dpal dmar po dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ lhag ma mchog sbyin dang ral gri/ spos kyi glang po ljang khu mchog sbyin dang bum par gnas pa'i glang po che'i sna 'dzin pa/ ye shes tog ser po g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yon mchog sbyin/ lhor bzang skyong dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rin po che blo gros rgya mtsho dmar po phyag gnyis sor mo thams cad brkyang ba chu rlobs pa'i tshul byed pa/ blo gros mi bzad pa gser mdog g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon khu tshur snying khar/ spobs pa brtsegs pa ljang khu g.yas se gol gtogs pa/ g.yon khu tshur mkhal khung du bzhag pa/ nub tu mthu chen thob dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon bag tsam kha bye ba'i pad+ma/ ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis sdig pa sprug pa'i tshul/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros phyag gnyis kha sbyar ba bteg pa'i tshul/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i nyi ma/ byang du zla 'od dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa lar gnas pa'i zla ba/ 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis dbang bskur ba'i bum pa/ nam mkha' mdzod ser po g.yon rdo rje khu tshur 'gying ba dkur brten pa/ g.yas pas nam mkha' la bskor ba/ sgrib sel dkar po g.yon sa la reg pa/ g.yas mthe bong gi khu tshur sdigs mdzub sbyar te dri ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa/ thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rigs kyi bdag po bzhin du zhal gsum phyag drug gi byams 'jam dbyangs ma gtogs thams cad kyi gnyis pa gnyis mnyam bzhag kun gyi lhag ma gnyis gzhu dang mda' 'dzin pa/ 'khor tshogs thams cad gtso bo dang mtshungs par brgyan cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa'i zhal sgeg pa'i nyams can/

shar sgor ma he'i steng du gshin rje mthar byed nag po sngo ba'i zhal bzhad pa/ gnyis pa 'jigs pa/ gsum pa gdangs pa/ bzhi pa 'jigs su rung ba/ lnga pa rdo rje'i mche ba can/ drug pa mgo bo'i steng du gnas pa ljags 'gul ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen du bgreng bas sdigs par byed pa/ gnyis pa lha mo dkar mo g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon pad dkar 'dzin pa'i nu ma 'dzin pa/ gsum pa dngul gyi gzhu/ g.yas logs su lha mo ljang khu ut+pal sngon po dang*/ g.yon pas yab kyi ske nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs drug gsus pa 'phyang ba/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa ser po/ phyag drug gi g.yas rnams rdo rje/ dbyug tho/ mda'/ nub tu rta mgrin dmar po phyag drug gi g.yas rnams rdo rje dbyug pa/ ka na ya dang mda'/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rkang pas bgegs mnan pa phyag drug gi g.yas rnams ral gri/ dgra sta/ mda'/ dbang ldan du rin po che'i ri bo'i steng mi g.yo ba phyag drug gi g.yas rnams ral gri/ zhags pa/ mda'/ g.yon ngos su 'chang ba'i gos sngon po khrag gis brlan pa'i ljags 'gul zhing zhal gdangs pa'o/ mer 'dod rgyal phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang gi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon nu ma dang gzhu/ bden bral du dbyug sngon can phyag drug gi g.yas rnams rdo rje/ mda'/ dbyug pa/ rlung du stobs po che phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rdo rje dbyug pa/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nu ma/ tho ba/ gzhu/ gtso bo'i steng du gnod mdzes rgyal po phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ 'og ma g.yas gnyis ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gnyis nu ma dang gzhu/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og phyag drug gi g.yas rnams rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ thams cad kyis g.yon rnams kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/

nu ma dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa man gyi khro bo rnams sngon po/ thams cad kyang zhal gsum khros pa'i stang stabs can spyan rtsa dmar ba smin ma g.yo ba/ bag tsam rtsa ba'i zhal kha phye ba/ g.yon ma mchu mnan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag lpags smad du gyon pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas dbu brgyan pa/ dbu skra 'bar ba gyen du bcings shing 'khyil ba/ sma ra dmar ser/ phud kyi sgra sgrog pa dang bcas pa'i klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ shes rab ma g.yon du gnas pa/ sna tshogs pad nyi'i gdan la gshin rje mthar byed g.yas brkyang ba dang gzhan thams cad g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa gtso bo'i thugs kar mūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥsnying po/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li bigha nān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭ/ las thams cad pa'o// chos dbyings gsung dbang ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te thams cad 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la ma he la gshin rje mthar byed nag po sngo ba'i zhal bzhad pa/

gnyis pa 'jigs pa/ gsum pa gdangs pa/ bzhi pa 'jigs su rung ba lnga pa rdo rje'i mche ba can/ drug pa mgo bo'i steng du gnas pa ljags 'gul ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas rnams lcags kyu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dril bu/ gzhu/ zhabs drug gsus pa 'phyang ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed ser po zhal bzhi rtsa ba'i zhal sgeg pa/ g.yas gdangs pa/ rgyab drag po chen po/ g.yon zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams zhags pa/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon snying kar lcags kyu/ dril bu/ mdung*/ gzhu/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po zhal bzhi dmar po rtsa zhal sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po rgyab bzhad pa/ g.yon zhi ba phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang*/ lcags sgrog lhag ma g.yas gsum rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum dril bu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa gzhu/ de gsum rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i tshul gyis dril bu dang*/ lhag ma'i g.yas gsum ral gri/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ dril bu/ tshogs bdag g.yon brkyang gis mnan pa/ dbang ldan du 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngon po sngo pa'i zhal bzhi rtsa zhal khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po/ rgyab dpa' ba/ g.yon mi sdug pa/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdor dril dang bcas bzung nas thugs kar hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gsum ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon brkyang bas u ma'i nu ma brdzis pa/ mer rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba/ nag pa'i zhal bzhi sgeg pa dang*/ dpa' ba dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ snying rje'i ro dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rdo rje/
