ral gri/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon na dril bu/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'brel ba'i ba dan/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab mjug g.yas brkyang gis mnan pa/ bden bral du he ru ka rdo rje sngon po sngo ba'i zhal bzhi drag po dang*/ bzhad pa dang*/ za bar rngam pa dang*/ sgeg pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang*/ mda'/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yon snying kar pad+ma kha bye ba/ gzhu/ dril bu/ ba dan dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lhag ma'i phyag g.yas kyis 'jigs byed kyi lpags pa rlung gis g.yo ba 'dzin pa/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa g.yon brkyang gis mnan pa/ rlung du rta mchog ljang khu ljang ba'i rtsa zhal khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po dang*/ g.yon tshangs pa lta bu/ spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams sna tshogs rdo rje ba dan gsum pa'i tshul dang*/ ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon rnams phub dang bcas pa'i phyag gis sna tshogs chu skyes/ shak+ti/ dbyug pa/ gzhu/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas brkyang gcig gis dbang mo dang dpa' mo/ g.yas bskum gcig gis dga' mo dang tshig ma/ g.yon bskum gcig gis dbang mo dang sbrang rtsir byed ma/ g.yon brkyang gcig gis rgyal bar byed pa dang dpyid kyi lha mnan nas gnas pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams 'khor lo/ lcags kyu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis dril bu/ zhags pa/ bgrang 'phreng*/ gzhu/ rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po zhal drag po dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bzhad pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i nyams can bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rdo rje dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams dril bu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ bgrang 'phreng*/ gzhu/ rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ smin ma 'khyog pa/ stag lpags stod smad du dkris pa/

thod phreng gis cod pan can dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bcings pa/ sma ra ser po/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ phyi ma zlum po nang ma gru bzhi gsum bzhi pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar seng ge'i steng du pad zla la 'jam pa'i dbyangs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od dang ldan pa sku mdog gser lta bu in+d+ra nī la 'dra ba'i zur phud rdo rje dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje 'phreng ba'i cod pan gyi steng du sangs rgyas lnga dang rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ rang lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas gdab pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' rnam pa mang po mnabs pa/ sgeg pa'i nyams thams cad dang ldan pa/ ser sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas rnams ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon rnams sher phyin gyi po ti/ gzhu/ dril bu/ 'dab ma brgyad la seng ge'i steng du pad zla la shar nas phyogs bzhir/ gtsug tor chen po dang*/ gdugs dkar po dang*/ gzi brjid phung po dang*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/ dbang ldan nas mtshams bzhir 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ cher 'phags pa dang*/ rgyal ba rnams ser po/ phyag g.yas kyis 'khor lo bzung ba dang g.yon rang gi gdan gnon pa/ rdo rje skyil krung can/ de'i shar gyi re mig gi dbus su glang po che'i rgyal po la mi bskyod pa sngon po/ zhal bzhi rtsa zhal sngon po khro ba dang bcas pa'i rol par ldan pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po kha gdangs pa drag po/

rgyab ser po dpa' ba/ g.yon mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas pa'i gung mos snying kar 'gying ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje gsor ba/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur bsnyems pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ lhor rdo rje rgyal po ser po g.yas lcags kyu 'gugs pa'i tshul gyis bcings pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa/ byang du rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu/ nub tu rdo rje legs pa ljang khu rdo rje dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis snying kar legs par 'byed pa'i tshul/ lho'i re mig gi dbus su rta mchog gi steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po ser nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po rdo rje rin po che ser po bzung nas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtha' gnyis la rdo rje gnyis kyis mtshan pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba gzung nas rang rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su 'ching bar byed cing*/ g.yon rdo rje dril bu snyems pas dkur brten pa/ lhor rdo rje gzi brjid dmar po snying kar phyag gnyis kyis nyi ma/ byang du rdo rje tog ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis g.yon gyi bar lhur gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub tu rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po phyag gnyis so'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa'i rdo rje khar bzhag pa/ nub kyi re mig gi dbus su rma bya'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas dmar po dmar nag ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po pad+ma/ de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje chos dmar skya g.yon 'gying ba'i tshul gyis pad+ma'i yu ba nas gzung zhing*/ g.yas pas de kha 'byed pa/ lhor rdo rje rnon po nam mkha'i mdog can g.yon pa thugs kar sher phyin gyi po ti/ g.yas pa ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul/

byang du rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yon pa'i gung mos 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor zhing*/ g.yas chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ nub tu rdo rje bsrung ba dmar po chos kyi dung dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rtse 'dzin pa/ byang gi re mig gi dbus su khyung gi steng du don yod grub pa ljang khu rtsa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal ser po zhi ba/ rgyab zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub/ de'i shar gyi 'dab mar rdo rje las ljang khu g.yas snying kar bslang ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa dang g.yon sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ lho ru rdo rje bsrung ba ser po phyag gnyis rdo rje'i go cha/ byang du rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mthe'u chung gnyis kyis rdo rje mche ba'i mtshon gyi rtse mo rang gi khar bcug pas/ bdud rnams sdigs par byed pa/ nub tu rdo rje khu tshur ser po khu tshur gyis gzung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ sangs rgyas gtso bo thams cad kyi phyag lhag ma g.yon rnams dril bu/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ g.yas rnams ral gri/ rdo rje mda'/ lcags kyu/ thams cad chibs kyi steng du pad nyi'i gdan la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang*/ sems dpa' bcu drug sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa/ dbang ldan nas mtshams kyi re mig tu sna tshogs pad zla la sangs rgyas spyan ma rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od dang ldan pa sku mdog gser lta bu in+t+ra nī la 'dra ba'i zur phud rdo rje dang pad+ma rin po che dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan gyi steng du sangs rgyas lnga dang rin po che'i con pan can/ rang lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan dang na bza' mang po mnabs pa/

sgeg pa'i nyams thams cad dang ldan pa ser sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas rnams ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon rnams sher phyin gyi po ti/ gzhu/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ma mā kī sngon mo zhal bzhi rtsa zhal sngon po khro ba dang bcas pa'i rol par ldan pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po kha gdangs pa drag po/ rgyab zhal ser po dpa' ba/ g.yon mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po pad+ma/ sgrol ma ljang khu rtsa zhal ljang khu mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal ser po zhi ba/ rgyal zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub/ lhag ma g.yon rnams dril bu/ gzhu/ zhags pa/ g.yas rnams ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dmar ser rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang*/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar mo rdo rje'i lcags sgrog phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin pa sa ka'i stang stabs/ byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang khu/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zlum po'i stang stabs kyis gnas pa/ bzhi ka'ang sna tshogs pad nyir gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa dbu skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ sma ra ser po dang ldan pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gnyis pa'i shar gyi dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis mos pas/ spyod pa dmar mo pad+ma dkar po/ rab tu dga' ba dmar mo yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ dri med ma dkar mo chu skyes/ 'od byed ma dmar mo sna tshogs pad+mar gnas pa'i nyi ma/ 'od 'phro ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po/

sbyangs dka' ma ser mo pang par gnas pa'i phyag gan rkyal gyis ma rā ka ta'i nor bu/ mngon du gyur ma gser mdog pad+ma'i steng du sher phyin gyi po ti/ ring du song ba ma sngon mo sna tshogs pad+mar gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ mi g.yo ba dkar mo zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga dmar pos mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i yu ba/ legs pa'i blo gros ma dkar mo ral gris mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ chos kyi sprin ma ser mo chos kyi sprin gyis yongs su bskor ba'i sher phyin gyi po ti/ kun tu 'od ma nyi ma bye ba'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng du bde bar gshegs pa'i sku/ thams cad kyi g.yas rdo rje/ lhor rin po che pad+ma'i pha rol tu phyin ma dmar mo// g.yon pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin ma dkar dmar g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma/ tshul khrims kyi phar phyin ma dkar mo g.yon mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang bcas pa'i me tog gi chun po/ bzod pa'i phar phyin ma ser mo g.yon chu skyes dkar po/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin ma ma rā ka ta lta bu g.yon ut+pal sngon po/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin ma sngo bsangs g.yon pad+ma dkar po/ shes rab kyi phar phyin ma gser mdog phyag bzhi'i g.yon dang po pad+ma la gnas pa'i sher phyin gyi po ti/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ thabs kyi phar phyin ma ljang khu g.yon pad ser la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ smon lam gyi phar phyin ma sngon mo g.yon ut+pal sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri/ stobs kyi phar phyin ma dmar mo g.yon sher phyin gyi po ti/ ye shes kyi phar phyin ma dkar mo g.yon rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'bras bus brgyan pa'i byang chub shing gi yal ga rdo rje las kyi phar phyin ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i rdo rje/ thams cad kyi g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ nub tshe la dbang ba ma dkar la dmar ba g.yon pa ting nge 'dzin gyis phyag rgyas pad+ma rā ga la gnas pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku/

sems la dbang ba ma dkar mo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dmar po/ yo byad la dbang ba ma ser mo nor bu'i rgyal mtshan las la dbang ba ma ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje/ skye ba la dbang ba ma sna tshogs mdog me tog dza ri kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba ma sngo bsangs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi zla/ mos pa la dbang ba ma dkar po g.yon pri yang ku lta bu'i me tog gi snye ma/ smon lam la dbang ba ma dmar ser ut+pal sngon po/ ye shes la dbang ba ma sngon mo ut+pal sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri/ chos la dbang ba ma dkar mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa bzang po// thams cad kyi g.yas pad+ma/ de bzhin nyid ma dkar mo g.yas pad dkar/ g.yon rdo rje rin po che'i snye ma/ sangs rgyas byang chub ma gser zhun lta bu/ g.yas pad ser/ g.yon nor bu'i rgyal mtshan gyi steng du 'khor lo/ byang du dbyig gi blo gros ma ser mo g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma/ rin chen skar mda' ma dmar mo nor bu'i rgyal mtshan// gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma dkar mo zla shel gyi bum pa/ 'od zer can dkar dmar skud bcas kyi khab/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ser mo rma bya'i mjug sgro// dzaṃ gu li ljang ser dug gi me tog gi chun po/ sgo mtha' yas ma ljang khu chu skyes dmar po la gnas pa'i gter bum/ tsun dā ma dkar mo bgrang 'phreng 'chang ba'i spyi blugs /shes rab 'phel ma dkar mo ut+pal sngon po la gnas pa'i ral gri/ las dang sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ma ljang khu rdo rje rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar dmar/ ye shes mi zad pa'i za ma tog ma dmar mo rin po che'i za ma tog sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos mdzod ma ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi dpe sgrom/ thams cad kyi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sgor chos so so yang dag par rig pa ma dkar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ lho sgor don so sor yang dag par rig pa ma ma rā ka ta'i mdog can phyag gnyis rin po che'i zhags pa/

nub sgor nges pa'i tshig so sor yang dag par rig pa ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyi mtha' gnyis su pad+mas mtshan pa'i lcags sgrog byang sgor spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dril bu/ mer sgeg mo ser mo sgeg pa dang bcas pa'i phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje re re/ bden bral du 'phreng ba dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ rlung du glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis pi wang bsgreng ba/ dbang ldan du gar ma ljang khu gar byed pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rtse gsum dang rdo rje dril bu/ mos spyod ma nas brtsams pa'i lha mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ cod pan gos sna tshogs pa cung zad 'dzum dang sgeg pa'i nyams sna tshogs pad zlar sems skyil gyis/ sgo skyong ma rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhal yas khang gsum pa'i dbang ldan nas brtsams te shar gyi snam bu la kun tu bzang po ser po g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal la gnas pa'i ral gri/ blo gros mi zad pa ser po ral gri dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas pad+ma/ sa snying ser po sa gnon dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i dpag bsam shing*/ nam snying ljang khu rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa dang yid bzhin nor bu/ lho phyogs kyi snam bu la nam mkha' mdzod ser po yid gyi bzhin nor bu dang bum pa bzang pos bcings pa'i dpag bsam shing*/ phyag na rin chen ljang khu rin po che dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ blo gros rgyal mtsho dkar po dung dang*/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ rdo rje snying po sngon po rdo rje dang mdo sde sa bcu pa'i po ti/ nub kyi snam bur spyan ras gzigs dkar po mchog sbyin dang chu skyes dkar po/ mthu chen thob ser po ral gri dang pad+ma/ zla 'od dkar po rdo rje 'khor lo dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dkar dmar ral gri dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma/

byang gi snam bu la 'od dpag med dkar po sna tshogs pad+ma dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i bum pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa ser po se gol dang pad+ma la gnas pa'i ral gri/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros gur kum lta bu rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang shak+ti/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sngon po ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ba dan/ bcu drug po thams cad pad zla la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ cod pan/ gos sna tshogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ shar gyi sgor ma he la gshin rje mthar byed nag po sngo ba'i zhal bzhad pa/ gnyis pa 'jigs pa/ gsum pa gdangs pa/ bzhi pa 'jigs su rung ba/ lnga pa rdo rje'i mche ba can/ drug pa mgo bo'i steng du gnas pa/ ljags 'gul ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas rnams lcags kyu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams sdig mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dril bu/ gzhu/ zhabs drug gsus pa 'phyang ba/ lhor shes rab mthar byed ser po zhal bzhi rtsa ba'i zhal sgeg pa/ g.yas gdangs pa/ rgyab drag po chen po*/ g.yon zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams zhags pa/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon snying kar lcags kyu/ dril bu/ mdung*/ gzhu/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po zhal bzhi dmar po rtsa zhal sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po/ rgyab bzhad pa/ g.yon zhi ba/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang*/ lcags sgrog lhag ma'i g.yas gsum rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon gsum dril bu sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ de gsum rol pas gnas pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed sngon po sngo ba'i zhal bzhi phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i tshul gyis dril bu dang*/ lhag ma'i g.yas gsum ral gri/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ dril bu/ tshogs bdag g.yon brkyang gis mnan pa dbang ldan du 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngon po sngo ba'i zhal bzhi rtsa zhal khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa/

g.yas zhal drag po/ rgyab dpa' ba/ g.yon mi sdug pa phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis rdor dril dang bcas bzung nas thugs kar hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma'i g.yas gsum ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ g.yon gsum rdo rje/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas dbang phyug chen po'i mgo bo mnan pa/ g.yon brkyang pas u ma'i nu ma brdzis pa/ mer rdo rje nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba nag pa'i zhal bzhi sgeg pa dang*/ dpa' ba dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ snying rje'i ro dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rdo rje/ ral gri/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon rnams dril bu/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'brel ba'i ba dan/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i khyab mjug g.yas brkyang gis mnan pa/ bden bral du he ru ka rdo rje sngon po sngo ba'i zhal bzhi drag po dang*/ bzhad pa dang*/ za bar rngam pa dang sgeg pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang*/ mda'/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ g.yon snying kar pad+ma kha bye ba/ gzhu/ dril bu/ ba dan dang bcas pa'i khaṭ+wāṃ ga lhag ma'i phyag g.yas kyis 'jigs byed kyi pags pa rlung gis g.yo ba 'dzin pa/ chung ma dang bcas pa'i tshangs pa g.yon brkyang gis mnan pa/ rlung du rta mchog ljang khu ljang ba'i rtsa zhal khro ba dang bcas pa'i sgeg pa/ g.yas drag po dang*/ g.yon tshangs pa lta bu/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams sna tshogs rdo rje ba dan gsum pa'i tshul dang*/ ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon rnams phub dang bcas pa'i phyag gi sna tshogs chu skyes/ shak+ti/ dbyug pa/ gzhu/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas brkyang gcig gis dbang mo dang dpa' mo// g.yas bskum gcig gis dga' mo dang tshil ma/ g.yon bskum gcig gis dbang mo dang sbrang rtsir byed ma/ g.yon brkyang gcig gis rgyal bar byed pa dang*/ dpyid kyi lha mnan nas gnas pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams 'khor lo/

lcags kyu/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis dril bu/ zhags pa/ bgrang 'phreng*/ gzhu/ rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po nag pa'i zhal bzhi drag po dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bzhad pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i nyams can phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rdo rje dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ ral gri/ mda'/ g.yon rnams dril bu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ rtse gsum/ gzhu/ g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ smin ma 'khyog pa/ stag lpags stod smad du dkris pa/ thod 'phreng gi cod pan can/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du bcings pa/ sma ra ser po/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ 'jigs su rung ba/ khro bo'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhi'i g.yas logs su rim pa bzhin me tog ma ser mo me tog gi snod/ bdug spos ma nag mo bdug spos/ mar me ma dkar mo sgron me/ dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos// g.yon logs su rim pa bzhin/ gzugs ma ser mo me long*/ sgra ma ljang khu pi wang*/ ro ma dmar mo ro snod/ reg bya ma sna tshogs mdog can gos sna tshogs/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyan dang cod pan gos sna tshogs cung zad 'dzum pa dang*/ sgeg pa'i nyams sna tshogs pad zlar sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i shar gyi phyogs su dbang po ser po glang po che sa srung gi steng na gnas pa rdo rje dang nu ma/ lhor ma he'i steng du gshin rje nag po dbyug tho dang rtse gsum/ nub tu chu srin gyi steng du chu bdag dkar po gdeng ka bdun pa klu'i zhags pa dang dung dkar/ byang du mi'i steng du lus ngan ser po lcags kyu dang dbyug tho/ byang shar du glang gi steng du dbang ldan dkar po ral pa'i thor cog la zla phyed bcings pa sprul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa dang ldan pa mgrin pa sngon po rtse gsum dang thod pa/ mer ra la me lha dmar po blugs gzar dang spyi blugs/

bden bral du ro la srin po'i bdag po sngon po ral gri dang phub/ rlung du ri dwags la rlung lha sngon po rlung ras de brgyad po phyag bzhi g.yas dang pos phyag mtshan so so dang po ti/ g.yon dang pos phyag mtshan so so dang rang snang gi btsun mo la 'khyud cing rlung ras 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i phyag gnyis gtso bo la 'dud pa'i tshul gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba/ dbang ldan dang nye ba'i phyi rol tu de nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis tshangs pa gdong bzhi ser po ngang pa la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs gzung nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ khyab 'jug nag po khyung la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dung*/ 'og ma gnyis mdung thung dang swa raṃ ga'i gzhu 'dzin pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ dbang phyug chen po dkar po glang la zhon pa ral pa'i thor cog zla tshes kyis spras pa phyag bzhi'i dang po spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis rtse gsum dang thod pa/ gdong drug dmar po rma bya la zhon pa gdong dang phyag drug g.yas gnyis shāk+ti dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis khyim bya dang dril bu/ lhag ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ de rnams rang rang gi bu mo la 'khyud pa/ tshangs pa gdong bzhi ser po ngang pa la zhon pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis bgrang 'phreng pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs bzung nas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ drag mo dkar mo glang la zhon pa thor cog zla tshes kyis spras pa phyag bzhi'i dang po spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis rtse gsum dang thod pa/ khyab 'jug ma nag po khyung la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis 'khor lo dang dung*/ 'og ma gnyis mdung thung dang swa raṃ ga'i gzhu 'dzin pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ gzhon nu ma dmar mo rma bya la zhon pa gdong dang phyag drug gi g.yas gnyis shak+ti dang rdo rje/

g.yon gnyis khyim bya dang dril bu/ lhag ma gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ dbang mo ser mo glang po che sa srung gi steng du gnas pa/ rdo rje dang nu ma/ phag mo nag mo 'ug pa la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ro hi ta'i nya dang thod pa/ tsā muṇ+ḍi dmar mo ri dwags la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri thod/ bhṛṅgi ma nag mo shin tu skem pa phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis 'phreng ba dang spyi blugs/ gsum ka'i phyag lhag ma gnyis thal sbyar/ tshogs bdag dkar po byi ba la zhon pa glang po che'i gdong can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis dgra sta dang la phug nag po chen po sngon po rtse gsum dang thod pa/ dga' byed dbang phyug nag bo rdza rnga la zhon pa rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson pa/ nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis 'dren pa'i shing rta la zhon pa phyag gnyis kas pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma 'dzin pa/ zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa phyag gnyis kas ku mu da la gnas pa'i zla ba 'dzin pa/ mig dmar dmar po ra la zhon pa gri gug dang mi mgo za ba'i tshul/ lag pa ser po pad+ma'i steng du mda' gzhu/ phur bu dkar po thod pa la zhon pa phreng ba dang*/ spyi blugs/ pa wa sangs dkar po pad+ma la gnas pa 'phreng ba dang spyi blugs/ spen pa nag po rus sbal la gnas pa dbyug pa/ sgra gcan dmar nag lag gnyis nyi ma dang zla ba 'dzin pa/ mjug rings nag po ral gri dang klu zhags/ stobs bzang dkar po glang po la gnas pa ral gri dang gshol/ rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu bya ko ka la'i shing rta la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ mda'/ g.yon gnyis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po ne tso'i shing rta la gnas pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu/ dpyid kyi lha dkar po spre'u la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis mda' dang ral gri/

g.yon gnyis btung ba'i snod dang gzhu/ klu mtha' yas dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ stobs rgyu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ rigs ldan rnams sbrul mgo bdun dang ldan pa thal mo sbyar ba/ thag bzang ris dang stobs ldan dang*/ tshim byed dang*/ rnam par snang byed la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi dbang po chen po rnams mdog nag po go cha sna tshogs bgos pa ral gri dang*/ ber ka la sogs pa'i mtshon cha 'chang ba/ nam mkha' lding gi dbang po gshog pa brkyang ba pus mo'i bar du dkar po/ de'i steng lte ba'i bar ser po/ de'i steng mgrin pa'i bar dmar po/ de'i steng mgo bo'i bar nag po/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dmar ser dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa ser po gnyis pi waṃ gi sgra sgrog pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po don kun grub pa dkar po me tog gi 'phreng ba can/ gang ba bzang po sngon po/ nor bu bzang po ser po/ nor sbyin dmar po/ rnam thos kyi bu ser po/ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li dkar po/ ki li mi li ljang khu/ sgo'i dbang po ser po/ de thams cad g.yas bi dza pū ra ka g.yon ne'u le/ 'phrog ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis zan chang*/ tha skar dkar po/ bra nye ljang khu/ smin drug sngo bsangs/ snar ma dmar skya/ mgo nag po/ lag dang nabs so ser po/ rgyal sngo bsangs// skag dkar po/ mchu ser po/ gre ljang ser/ sbo ljang khu/ me bzhi dkar po/ nag pa ljang khu/ sa ri ser po/ sa ga nag po/ lha mtshams ljang khu/ snron ser po/ snrubs ser po/ chu stod nag po/ chu smad dkar po/ gro bzhin dkar ser/ mon gre nag po/ mon gru ser po/ khrums stod ljang khu/ khrums smad ser po/ nam gru dkar ser/ byi zhun sngo bsangs/ de thams cad stod g.yogs g.yo ba dang bcas pa thal mo sbyar ba/ dbang po la sogs pa pad+ma dang*/ gzhan rnams shing rta la gnas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gos sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phyag 'tshal zhing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa thams cad du sgrog pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dmar ser rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang*/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ser po rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar mo rdo rje'i lcags sgrog phyag gnyis kyis 'dzin pa sa ka'i stang stabs/ byang du rdo rje 'bebs pa ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas zlum po'i stang stabs kyis gnas pa/ bzhi ka'ang sna tshogs pad nyi la gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ sma ra ser po dang ldan pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar mūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ a a sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ ha ra ha ra oṃ hūṃ hrī/ bha ga wan dzñā na murti wa gī shwa ra ma hā pa tsa sarba dharma ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shud dhāḥdharma dha tu dzñā na gar+bha āḥ snying po/ oṃ amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li bigha nān+ta ka hūṃ/ las thams cad pa'o// ngan song sbyong ba ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/

de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du rlung dang me dang chu dang sa dang ri rab kyi steng du phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po rdo rje'i phreng ba sngon pos bskor ba/ de'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i seng ge'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal shākya seng ge rnam par snang mdzad chen po gser gyi mdog can chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nyid dang mtshungs pa'i rnam snang gis rgyas gdab pa/ shar gyi rtsibs la rdo rje gtsug tor dkar po sa gnon/ lhor rin chen gtsug tor sngon po mchog sbyin/ nub tu pad+ma'i gtsug tor dmar po bsam gtan gyi phyag rgya/ byang du sna tshogs gtsug tor ljang khu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mer gtsug tor gzi brjid sku mdog dkar dmar g.yas nyi ma g.yon dkur brten pa bden bral du gtsug tor rgyal mtshan dkar nag 'dres ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ rlung du gtsug tor rnon po sngo bsangs ral gri dang po ti/ dbang ldan du gtsug tor gdugs dkar po phyag drug gis gdugs 'dzin pa/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i phyi'i me la sogs pa'i mtshams su sgeg mo dang*/ phreng ba ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma rnams dkar ser dmar sna tshogs mdog can phyag gnyis ma/ snam bu la sgo'i g.yon logs su byams pa ser po g.yas klu shing gi me tog g.yon spyi blugs/ mthong ba don yod ser po spyan ma dang bcas pa'i g.yas pad+ma/ g.yas logs su ngan song kun 'dren dkar po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad 'joms pa'i blo gros dkar ser 'dres pa g.yas dbyug pa/

lho'i g.yon logs su spos kyi glang po dkar ljang g.yas dri'i dung phor/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dkar po g.yas ral gri/ g.yas logs su nam mkha' mdzod dkar ser pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ ye shes tog sngon po g.yas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub kyi g.yon logs su bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar po g.yas cod pan gyi steng du bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ zla ba'i 'od dkar po g.yas pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba/ g.yas logs su bzang skyong dkar po g.yas rin po che 'bar ba/ drwa ba can gyi 'od dmar po g.yas rdo rje'i gur/ byang gi g.yon logs su rdo rje snying po sngo skya g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ut+pal sngon po/ blo gros mi zad pa dkar po phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ g.yas logs su spobs pa brtsegs pa dkar po g.yas chu skyes la gnas pa'i rin po che brtsegs pa/ kun bzang gser mdog g.yas rin po che'i snye ma/ g.yon thams cad khu tshur dkur brten pa/ mer me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma nag mo/ mar me ma dmar mo/ dri chab ma ljang khu/ phyag gnyis kyis rang ming gi mchod pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa sngon mo zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du rdo rje 'bebs ma ljang khu rdo rje'i dril bu/ gtso 'khor de thams cad lha'i gos sna tshogs pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can sna tshogs pad zla la sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ pad+ma'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i 'khor yug gi nang du/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis/ glang la mgrin sngon can dmar po mchod phyir thogs pa can g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchod sbyin/ g.yon gnyis rtse gsum dang ral gri/ nam mkha' lding la khyab 'jug nag po g.yas rdo rje dang dbyug tho// g.yon gnyis dung dang 'khor lo/

phyag mtshan de dang 'dra ba'i gser gyi rdo rje ma gser mdog can/ rma bya la rdo rje dril bu gdong drug pa dmar po g.yas gnyis khyim bya dang dril bu/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje dril bu gzhon nu ma/ ngang pa la sgra rdo rje ser po zhal bzhi g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang zla ba'i 'phreng ba g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje zhi ba ma/ glang po che mche ba drug pa dang zla ba la rdo rje mtshon cha dkar po rol pa'i kun tu bskyod pas gnas pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rdo rje dkur brten pa/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje khu tshur ma/ rta bdun gyi shing rta la rdo rje 'khyil pa dmar po khros pa g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi dkyil/ de dang mtshungs pa rdo rje bdud rtsi ma/ ngang pa la rdo rje dkar po khro ba g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje 'od dpag ma/ ra la rdo rje dmar ser khro bo g.yas rdo rje dkar po/ g.yon mi gzung nas za ba/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje ska rags ma/ pad+ma la rdo rje zhi ba khro bo ser po g.yas mda'/ g.yon gzhu/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje zhi ba ma/ sbal pa la rdo rje bla ma khro bo ser po g.yas bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje bla ma ma pad+ma la rdo rje pa ba sangs khro bo dkar po g.yas bgrang 'phreng dang g.yon spyi blugs/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje pa ba sangs ma/ rus sbal la rdo rje dbyug pa khro bo nag po g.yas pa na dbyug pa/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje dbyug pa ma/ rdo rje sgra gcan khro bo dmar nag g.yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon nyi ma/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje lha min mo// rdo rje mjug ring khro bo nag po g.yas ral gri/ g.yon sbrul zhags/ de dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje glu ma/ glang po che la rdo rje glang dkar po g.yon gshol rdo rje dul ba ma g.yon khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa la gzhan de bzhin/

bya ko ka la'i shing rta la rdo rje 'phreng ba can ljang khu g.yon me tog gi 'phreng ba/ rdo rje gdan ma g.yon dung 'dzin pa gzhan de bzhin/ ne tso'i shing rta la rdo rje dbang can ser po g.yon chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje dbang can ma sku mdog dmar mo gzhan de bzhin/ sbal pa la rdo rje rnam par rgyal ma dkar mo g.yon ral gri/ rdo rje gdan ma gzhan de bzhin la me tog 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gtun shing ser po g.yas dbyug tho g.yon gtun shing*/ rdo rje pho nya mo g.yon khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa gzhan de bzhin/ ra la rdo rje me dmar po g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang go cha/ g.yon gnyis dbyug tho dang spyi blugs/ rdo rje 'bar ma de bzhin/ ma he la rdo rje nag po g.yon lcags kyu/ ro langs rdo rje ma nag mo g.yon khaṭ+wāṃ ga klu lhag ma la rdo rje lcags kyu sngon po/ phag zhal g.yon lcags kyu/ mi la rdo rje gdong ma g.yon ral gri/ chu srin la rdo rje klu dkar po sbrul mgo brgyad dang ldan pa g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin/ ri dwags la rdo rje'i rlung sngon po g.yon rlung sgrib pa'i gos 'dzin pa/ rdo rje shugs can ma de bzhin/ ro langs rdo rje 'jigs byed sngon po g.yon dbyug pa/ rdo rje rnam par gtsigs ma g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa gzhan de bzhin/ byi ba la rdo rje log 'dren dkar po glang po che'i zhal g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis rtse gsum dang dbyug tho sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs/ bra ba byi ba la sprul ma sngon mo g.yon phyags shing*/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo g.yon pi waṃ/ seng ge bgrod dka' ma ljang khu g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis lde mig dang ral gri/ thams cad kyi g.yas rdo rje/ nub tu rdo rje klu dang nye bar pad+ma la gnas pa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ lha ma yin rnams mdog sna tshogs pa go bgos nas ral gri 'dzin pa ras bal gyi gdan 'jam pa la gnas pa klu rnams nor bu dang ldan pa'i gdengs ka can btsun mo dang bcas pa thal sbyar/

khor yug gi phyi'i mer dmyal ba/ bden bral du yi dwags/ rlung du dud 'gro/ dbang ldan du mi'i 'gro ba rnams so// // gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la mūm̐ḥde las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te*/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti sarba durga ti pa ri shodha na/ rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myaka saṃ budhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shud dhe bi shud dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud dhe swā hā/ 'phreng sngags/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i sngags/ oṃ sarba bita a pā ya ga ti ma hā na bhi shodha na hūṃ phaṭ/ las thams cad pa'o// 'byung po 'dul byed ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du ri rab kyi steng na sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su glang po che'i rgyal po de'i steng du sna tshogs pad zla la/

bcom ldan 'das 'byung po 'dul byed drag po chen po sku mdog sngon po thod pa lngas tshan pa'i cod pan la de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbu rgyan/ skra dmar ser gyen du bcings pa/ gos sngon po gyon pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar po sgeg pa'i bgad mo mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje sngon po 'jigs par gsor zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma'i phyag gnyis kyis rang gi phyag rgya mdzad pa klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po zla phyed kyis mtshan pa'i rdo rje can/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ thod pa lnga dang sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ lag pa bzhi g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gis mnan pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa/ shar gyi re mig la glang dang nyi mar dbang phyug chen po mtshan ma gyen du langs pa thod pa can thal ba'i mdog spyan gsum pa/ zla phyed kyis brgyan pa'i thor tsugs can sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang rtse gsum/ lhor mkha' lding dang nyi mar khyab 'jug nag po cod pan dmar po can g.yas gnyis rnga yab dang dung*/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ nub tu ngang pa dang zla ba'i steng tshangs pa dkar po gdong bzhi g.yas gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang gdugs/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang spyi blugs/ byang du rma bya dang nyi ma'i steng du smin drug gi bu/ dmar po gtsug phud gsum dang ldan pa rnga yab dang shak+ti/ dbang ldan du bra ba byi ba la tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i zhal spyan gsum spyi bor zla phyed kyis mtshan pa/ g.yas gnyis la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis rtse gsum dang thod pa/ mer nyi ma la nyi ma dmar mo/ phyag gnyis kyis mtsho skyes la gnas pa'i nyi dkyil/

bden bral du shing rta'i steng du nyi ma la gnas pa'i sgra gcan dmar nag dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal gdangs pa/ phyag gnyis nyi zlar bcas te thal mo sbyar ba/ rlung du zla ba'i steng du dga' byed dbang phyug ser po gar byed cing spyi bor zla phyed dang sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa can/ ḍa ma ru dang rtse gsum/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar du dpal mo dkar mo thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas me tog pad+ma/ lhor thig le mchog ma dmar mo gar byed cing spos snod/ nub tu zla ba ma dmar mo mar me/ byang du bka' bzlog ma ser mo gdengs ka'i lag pa bzlog nas spyi bor bzhag nas gar byed pa/ mer dpal mo dri'i dung phor/ bden bral du dbyangs can ma ljang khu pi waṃ sgrog pa/ rlung du mdzes ma nag mo rin po che'i phreng ba/ dbang ldan du dbang po 'byor ma ser mo phyag na rtse gsum/ de thams cad zla ba la gnas pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i shar du glang po che sa srung dang zla bar brgya byin ser po mig stong dang ldan pa rin po che'i cod pan can g.yas pa'i skyabs sbyin g.yon pas brten pa/ lhor ma he dang nyi mar gshin rje nag po gsus pa 'phyang ba/ spyan smin ma sma ra thams cad ser po gos ser po gyon pa/ thod pas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ nub tu sbrul dang zla bar chu lha dkar po gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa mchog sbyin dang sbrul zhags/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi steng du lus ngan po ser po sha rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba rin po che'i cod pan can dbyug tho dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mer ra dang nyi mar me lha dmar po ral pa gsum dang ldan pa skra dang sma ra dmar ser gsus pa 'phyang ba phrag pa la phyag tshang ku ba btags pa mchod phyir thogs pa can/ g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis rtse gsum dang spyi blugs/

bden bral du ro langs dang nyi mar srin po nag po sma ra dmar ser ral gri dang mi shas gang ba'i thod pa/ rlung du ri dwags dang zla ba la rlung lha sngon po gtsug phud gsum pa phyag gnyis rlung ras/ byang shar du ngang pa dang zla ba la dbang ldan dkar po ku mu ta la gnas pa'i zla ba dang mchog sbyin/ rim pa bzhi pa'i shar du seng ge'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma dkar mo ming gis mtshon pa'i phyag mtshan/ lhor rnam par rgyal ma dmar mo lcags kyu/ nub tu pad ldan ma ser dkar mda' gzhu// byang du chang 'phrog ma dmar mo nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ dbang ldan du mchog 'phrog ma ser mo thugs kar me tog dang bcas pa'i thal sbyar/ mer rin chen dbang phyug ma ser mo spos phor/ bden bral du rgyan ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos/ rlung du 'gro skyong ma ser mo mar me'i mchod sdong*/ de thams cad zla ba la gnas pa/ 'khor gyi lha thams cad sems dpa'i skyil krung can gos dang rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la sa bon hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ hūṃ badz+ra phaṭ/ snying po/ de nyid las thams cad pa yang ngo*/ gur rigs bsdus ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/

bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad 'od zer gyis 'gengs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su yang gzhal yas khang lnga tshoms kyi dbus ma la mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa ni byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad gyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pa dang*/ zhabs gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyis tshul gyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug drag po lha dbang ste bdud rnam pa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi snying ka mnan pa'i nyi ma la/

de'i yum mā ma ki sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*// skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ lhor tsau rī ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub tu bai ta li dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo ri rab/ shar lhor sha wa rī dkar mo byang sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngon mo me thab gru gsum/ nub byang du ḍoṃ bi nī ljang khu rgyal mtshan/ gzhal yas khang chen po'i shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog byang sgor dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu bsnams pa/ shar gyi gzhal yas khang du rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin/ nya nya khrab chen// rus sbal/ klu lag ldan/ ngang mo rnams gdong nang du bstan pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ da byid/ sbrul khra// nag dkar ba/ byi ba/ 'bri/ bya rgod/ bzhad rnams gdong phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/

shar gyi 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ skam pa ma dkar mo skam pa/ zhags ldan ma ser mo zhags pa/ nya dol ma dmar mo nya rgya/ lcags kyu ma dmar mo lcags kyu/ me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi snod/ bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can bdug spos kyi snod/ mar me ma dmar mo mar me'i snod/ dri chab ser mo dri'i dung chos/ lho'i gzhal yas khang du rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal ser po/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ bya ka lan ta ka ngur pa/ lug tsa ko ra/ byi khra/ hor khra/ 'ol ba/ nya khra rnams gdong nang du bstan pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na/ stobs rgyu/ dung skyong*/ rigs ldan/ pad+ma/ pad bzang*/ 'jog po/ nor rgyas/ mtha' yas rnams gdong phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ yum sgrol ma ser mo/ 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ nyi phyag ma dkar mo nyi ma/ mar me ma sngon mo mar me/ rin chen skar mda' ma ser mo rin po che/ glog phyag ma ljang khu glog phyag sgeg mo ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba/ glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis ting ting shag gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje dang bcas gar byed pa/ nub kyi gzhal yas khang du snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal nag pa/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ dbu re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/

dred/ bya rgod/ bse/ ba men/ stag spre'u/ chu srin/ lce spyang rnams gdong nang du bstan pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na/ khwa ta/ 'ug pa/ chu bya dkar po/ seng ge bzhad/ ra/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra/ phag rnams gdong phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ pad+ma ma dkar mo pad+ma/ chos 'byung ma ser mo chos 'byung*/ lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog rang 'khyud ma ljang khu sangs rgyas thams cad la rjes su chags pa'i phyag na rdo rje thod pa gzung nas rang la 'khyud pa/ gling bu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis gling bu 'bud pa/ pi waṃ ma ser mo pi wang bsgreng ba/ mu kun da ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rnga brdung ba/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga brdung ba/ byang gi gzhal yas khang du don grub dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ljang khu/ g.yas zhal nag pa/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ dbu re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ gza' lhag pa/ phur bu/ mjug ring*/ sgra gcan/ mig dmar/ pa ba sangs/ spen pa/ khyab mjug rnams gdong nang du bstan pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ dbang po/ tshangs pa/ drag po/ 'dod lha/ thod pa can/ gcer bu/ thag bzang ris/ stobs ldan rnams gdong phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ yum sgrol ma ljang khu/ 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ rdo rje sgo lcags ma dkar mo sgo lcags/ lde mig ma ser mo lde mig sgo 'dzin ma dmar mo sgo glegs/ yol 'dzin ma nag mo yol ba/ spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ ma mā kī sngon mo rdo rje/ gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma/ sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po bsnams shing*/ g.yon dmigs bsal med pa rnams sdigs mdzub/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ yum bzhi g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ lnga po gang yang rung ba dbus su bsgoms na so so'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro// gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ lhag ma'i sa bon/ oṃ traṃ a khaṃ/ snying po'i sngags/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ ma ra da ma ra da/ badz+ra ḍh+ṝka phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa ta e h+ye hi dzik hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sur+ya ta mo bi ta ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a ham̐ rat+na ḍh+ṝka phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu a ro l̥k hūṃ phaṭ/ oṃ phu phu hi hi pradzñā dhṛk phaṭ swā hā/ snying po'o/ na maḥsaman+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na maḥbadz+ra kro dha ya ma hā daṃṣ+ṭo ta u ta ka ṭa bhai ra bā yā/ badz+ra san+to ha dar sā ya a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ/ las thams cad pa'o// bde mchog 'khor lo sgyur drug ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas/ de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go/

de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje'i bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i shar gyi rtsibs la rdo rje dbyug pa sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po rdo rje tho ba/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma ser po ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i dang po dbyug pa/ nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor dmar po dmar dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ pad+ma dmar po/ lhor rdo rje 'khyil pa ljang khu ljang dkar ser ba'i zhal sna tshogs rdo rje/ mer rdo rje gnod sbyin du ba'i mdog dud kha dang ser ljang ba'i zhal/ lcags kyu/ srin por rdo rje dus mtshan dmar po dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal/ dgra sta/ rlung du nag po chen po sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ tri shu la 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba nag po nag ser ljang ba'i zhal/ ral gri/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dkar po dkar sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ 'khor lo/ de thams cad lhag ma'i phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og sngon po sngo ser ljang ba'i zhal/ rdo rje gtun shing dang*/ gnyis pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon gnyis klu'i zhags pa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas khaṭ+wāṃ ga thams cad rtsa ba'i phyag gis rang 'dra ba'i shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ zhal mi sdug par gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ 'jigs su rung ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar la zlum pa/

smin ma g.yo ba/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa/ dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga'i 'phreng ba dang*/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo lnga bcu mgul nas 'phyang ba/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan cing nyi ma la phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng tshangs pa/ 'og thag bzang ris brdzis te g.yas brkyang gis rtsibs kyi rtse mo la cung zad ma reg pa'i pad nyi la gnas pa/ 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par drag tu 'khor ba/ de'i lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su rlung dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ri rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa/ de'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de'i nang du gzhal yas khang drug tshoms kyi dbus ma'i nang du seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma gcer mo skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pas mtshan pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkhar 'phyar ba/

byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla la 'khyud pa/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ shar nas g.yon du skor ba'i sgo bzhir/ thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ ked rus chen po dang*/ keng rus dang*/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa rnams nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas// rab tu gtum mo dang*/ gtum pa'i mig can ma dang*/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma/ thal ba dkar po'i mdog can rnams rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ thod pa 'dzin ma rnams la 'khyud pa/ rim pa bzhin du mdun gyi gzhal yas khang dang po'i nang du seng ge'i steng du sna tshogs pad zla la tshangs pa'i snying khar rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tsugs can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thams can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ sgo rnams su lha dgra dang*/ 'od dpag med dang*/ rdo rje'i 'od dang*/ rdo rje'i lus rnams dkar po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpa' bo'i blo gros ma dang*/ mi thung ma dang*/ lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang*/ shing grib ma rnams ser mo 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub 'phyar zhing thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ de nas g.yas su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gnyis pa'i dbus su rta'i steng du sna tshogs pad nyir lha'i bu nyi ma'i snying kar rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser po rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pa rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo la 'khyud pa/

sgo bzhir myu gu can dang*/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang*/ dpa' bo chen po dang*/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rnams ser po rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pas sa srung ma/ 'jigs byed chen mo/ rlung gi shugs can ma/ chang 'thung ma ljang khu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ thams cad g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rnams la 'khyud pa/ gzhal yas khang gsum pa'i dbus su rma bya'i steng du sna tshogs pad nyir dbang phyug chen po'i snying gar rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ sgo bzhir rdo rje bzang mo dang*/ rdo rje'i 'od dang*/ 'jigs byed chen po dang*/ mig mi bzang rnams dmar po pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu 'dzin pas sngo bsangs lha mo dang*/ shin tu bzang mo dang*/ rta rna ma dang*/ bya gdong ma dkar mo pad+ma dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ thams cad g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rnams la 'khyud pa/ gzhal yas khang bzhi par glang po che'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi mar khyab mjug gi snying kar rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la 'khyud pa/ sgo bzhir rin chen rdo rje/ stobs po che/ rta mgrin/ nam mkha'i snying po rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pas 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ dum skyes ma/ chang 'tshong ma/ 'khor lo'i go cha ma ser mo rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ thams cad g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rnams la 'khyud pa/ gzhal yas khang lnga pa'i dbus su mkha' lding gi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi mar lha'i bu zla ba'i snying kar rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa don yod grub pa sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs dril bu 'dzin pas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu la 'khyud pa/

sgo bzhir he ru ka dang*/ pad+ma gar dbang dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pas shin tu bzang mo dang*/ stobs chen ma dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ma dang*/ brtson 'grus chen mo sngo skya sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ thams cad g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rnams la 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris pa mchod phyir thogs pa can/ mi mgo rlon pa'i 'phreng ba mgrin pa la 'phyang ba/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang mo/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rnams rim pa bzhin lcags kyu/ dril bu/ lcags sgrog zhags pa/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'jom ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas rnams rim pa bzhin me long*/ pi waṃ/ dri'i dung chos/ lha mo thams cad kyis g.yon thod khrag khaṭ+wāṃ ga lha mo rnams gcer bu skra grol zhing mi mgo skam po'i 'phreng ba mgul nas 'phyang ba/ thams cad kyang dpral ba'i steng du thod pa lnga dang phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi mtshams su sna tshogs pad+ma la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i thod pa/ 'khor rnams rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba lnga po dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la baṃ/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag

slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ bh+ruṃ āṃḥhrīḥhūṃ khaṃ/ lhag ma'i sa bon no// oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shrī bud+dha ḍā ka a la la bh+ruṃ āḥhūṃḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shrī rat+na ḍā ka traṃ āḥhūṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ka hriḥ.āḥhūṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka hūṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ shrī bi shwa ḍā ka hoḥ khaṃ aḥhūṃ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba raṃ hūṃ phaṭ swā hā/ las thams cad pa ni/ oṃ khaṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid thob par 'dod pas de'i ched du/ phung po khams skye mched la sogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan lta bu stong pa nyid dang ro gcig tu nges par byas te thams cad 'od gsal ba la rab tu 'jug go /de'i ngang las skad cig gis gcig tu sra zhing mkhregs la 'bar ba'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ de nas steng du shin tu mtho ba'i rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gur bar mtshams med pa dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi'i steng du rdo rje mda'i drwa ba dang nang du rdo rje bla re/ bskal pa'i mtha'i me dang 'dra ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba kun nas 'phro ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i steng gi rtsibs la gtsug tor can ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang*/ thod pa dang*/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang dgra sta/

g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang*/ thod pa dang tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ shar gyi rtsibs nas g.yas bskor du bgegs mthar byed nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri dang*/ gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang*/ thod pa dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ dbyug sngon can nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa/ shes rab mthar byed dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na me'i mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon na gzhu dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ 'dod rgyal dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ pad+ma mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na tho ba dang*/ mdung dang*/ rtse gsum pa/ g.yon na pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ me long dang*/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na tho ba da nga*/ mdung*/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang me long 'dzin pa/ gshin rje mthar byed ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang*/ 'jigs byed rdo rje g.yon na dung dang*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ stobs po ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rang rigs cod pan can/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa gdong re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ de'i lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po shin tu yangs pa'i dbus su rlung dang*/

me dang*/ chu dang*/ sa'i dkyil 'khor lhun po'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan la/ phyogs kyi 'khor lo thams cad 'od zer gyis 'gengs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku mdog sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ rdo rje nor bu dang*/ rdo rje rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje mgul rgyan dang*/ rdo rje gdu bu dang*/ rdo rje ska rags dang*/ rdo rje rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje 'phreng ba dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa mdun nas nag dmar dkar ba gsum re las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i dpung pa drug drug de las gnyis gnyis gyes pa'i phyag bcu gnyis bcu gnyis rang rang dang mdog mtshungs pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ sor mo rnams kyi tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes zhing*/ 'od 'phro ba g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje gnyis par ral gri/ gsum par rtse gsum/ bzhi par gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/ gnyis pa rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par mdung*/ gsum pa dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par khaṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par rgyas pa/

bzhi par khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/ bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por dung*/ gnyis par me long*/ gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrog bzhi par tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pa 'dzin pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi pa/ lag na me tog gi mda' lnga dang*/ gzhu dang zhags pa dang*/ lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dkar po'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa rtse gsum dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ thod pa dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ bdud dang drag po'i lha mo dga' ma dang u mas zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin cing*/ gdong dman par byed bzhin pa/ de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yas bskor gyis ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi re re la spyan gsum gsum/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas kyis gri gug lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma ru/ bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon na thod pa/ zhags pa/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang rin po che bsnams pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid can ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar dang me'i 'dab mar nag mo 'bar ma du ba ma gnyis nag mo nag dmar dkar ser ba'i zhal can/ dang po'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas spos/ tsan dan gur kum/ ga bur/ gla rtsi sbyar ba'i snod/ g.yon dril bu/ pad+ma/ lha shing gi me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho dang srin por dmar mo 'bar ma dang*/ smig sgyu ma/ gnyis dmar mo dmar ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal can/ dang po'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas mar me/

do shal/ cod pan/ gdu bu/ g.yon na bza'/ ska rags/ rna rgyan/ rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar mo 'bar ma dang mkha' snang ma gnyis dkar mo dkar nag ser dmar ba'i zhal can/ dang po'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas 'o ma/ chu mchog gi sman/ chang gi snod/ g.yon bdud rtsi/ grub pa'i bcud a ru ra/ zan gyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub dang rlung du ser mo 'bar ma dang mar me ma gnyis ser mo ser dkar dmar sngo ba'i zhal can/ dang po'i phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dung*/ gling bu/ nor bu/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon rgyud mang*/ rnga*/ mkhar rnga*/ zangs dung*/ mtshams ma thams cad phyag brgyad na rang rang gi mdog can gyi rnga yab 'dzin pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can mnyam pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o// zung bzhi'i dbang ldan du chos kyi dung dkar po// bden bral du chos kyis gaṇ+ḍī dmar po/ mer nor bu nag po/ rlung du dpag bsam gyi shing ser po/ don grub spyan mas 'khyud pa/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i shar gyi ling tsher/ sgrol ma rnam snang gis 'khyud pa med/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed rengs byed mas 'khyud pa shar sgor/ nam mkha'i snying po dri rdo rje mas 'khyud pa shar sgo'i g.yas su/ reg bya rdo rje ma sgrib pa rnam sel gyis 'khyud pa mer/ 'khyud bya thams cad nag po g.yas bskor gyi nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri dang*/ gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang thod pa dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ 'khyud byed thams cad ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can// phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ 'jigs byed rdo rje/ g.yon na dung dang*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rin 'byung ma mā kīs 'khyud pa lho'i ling tsher/ gos dkar mo 'od dpag med kyis 'khyud pa bden bral/

khro bo shes rab mthar byed khengs byed mas 'khyud pa lho sgor/ sa snying gzugs rdo rje mas 'khyud pa lho sgo'i g.yas su/ ro rdo rje ma 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'khyud pa bden bral du/ 'khyud bya thams cad dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na me'i mda' dang*/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon na gzhu dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ 'khyud byed thams cad dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na tho ba dang*/ mdung dang*/ rtse gsum g.yon na pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ me long dang*/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ 'od dpag med gos dkar mos 'khyud pa byang gi ling tsher/ ma mā kī rin 'byung gis 'khyud pa dbang ldan/ khro bo pad+ma mthar byed rmugs byed mas 'khyud pa byang sgor/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje mas 'khyud pa byang sgo'i g.yas su/ gzugs rdo rje ma sa'i snying pos 'khyud pa dbang ldan du/ 'khyud bya thams cad dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na tho ba dang*/ mdung dang rtse gsum pa/ g.yon na pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ me long dang*/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ 'khyud byed thams cad dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i cang te'u/ g.yon na gzhu dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ rnam snang sgrol mas 'khyud pa nub kyi ling tsher/ spyan ma don grub kyis 'khyud pa rlung du/ khro bo gshin rje mthar byed rab brtson mas 'khyud pa nub sgor/ sgrib pa rnam sel reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa nub sgo'i g.yas su/ dri rdo rje ma nam mkha'i snying pos 'khyud pa/ rlung du/ 'khyud bya thams cad ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na 'khor lo dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ 'jigs byed rdo rje g.yon na dung dang*/

rdo rje lcags sgrog dang sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'khyud byed thams cad nag po g.yas bskor gyi nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag drug gi g.yas na ral gri dang gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na phub dang thod pa dang*/ khaṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje sgra rdo rje mas 'khyud pa lho sgo'i g.yon du/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma kun tu bzang pos 'khyud pa nub sgo'i g.yon du/ gnyis ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang*/ thod pa dang*/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ kun tu bzang po chos dbyings rdo rje mas 'khyud pa shar sgo'i g.yon du/ sgra rdo rje ma phyag rdor gyis 'khyud pa byang sgo'i g.yon du/ gnyis sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ gri gug dang*/ dgra sta/ g.yon na rdo rje dril bu dang*/ thod pa dang tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas dang sems dpa' pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa la yum pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khyud pa/ gshegs ma dang sems ma pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du pad+ma'i gdan gyis bzhugs pa la yab rdo rje'i gdan gyis 'khyud pa/ thams cad zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ don grub/ rin 'byung*/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ rnam snang*/ rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa'i con pan can/ gzhan rnams la rang rigs kyi gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gyis rgyas btab pa yab phyag rgya drug yum rnams la phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing lha rdzas kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ khro bo thams cad kyang nas sham thabs can zhes pa'i bar bsrung 'khor bzhin pad dkar nyi ma'i steng du g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la khro bo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bde gshegs bzhi'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi ling tsher/ rkang dag pa'i bum pa gnyis shar du/

khrag dag pa'i bum pa gnyis lhor/ dri chu dag pa'i bum pa gnyis byang du/ dri chen dag pa'i bum pa gnyis nub tu/ khu ba dang rdul dag pa'i bum pa gnyis steng 'og tu/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa/ 'dir 'dab ma'i lha mo brgyad dang*/ bum pa rnams dang chos kyi dung sogs bzhag pa nyer lnga'i lha bsgom par yang gsungs so// gsung dkyil gyi pad+ma shar mar tsartsi ka dbang pos 'khyud pa ro dmar po'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar g.yas bskor gyis 'jigs ma dang*/ drag mo dang dus kyi mche ba mo dang*/ me 'bar gdong ma dang*/ rlung shugs ma dang*/ rab gtum ma dang*/ drag can ma dang*/ sna chen mas bskor ba/ thams cad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon na thod pa dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga mer khyab 'jug ma tshangs pa gdong bzhis 'khyud pa mkha' lding gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar g.yang mo dang*/ sgyu ma dang*/ grags ma dang*/ dpal mo dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ dpal ldan rgyal ma dang*/ rgyal byed ma dang*/ dpal ldan 'khor lo can mas bskor ba/ thams cad nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na 'khor lo dang*/ be con/ g.yon na pad+ma dang dung*/ lhor phag mo drag pos 'khyud pa ma he'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar keng rus ma dang*/ dus mtshan ma dang*/ rab tu khros pa'i gdong ma dang*/ dus kyi lce dang*/ gtsigs ma/ nag mo dang 'jigs rung ma dang*/ gzugs ngan mas bskor ba/ thams cad dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon na lcags sgrog dang phub/ bden bral du gzhon nu ma tshogs bdag gis 'khyud pa rma bya'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte ba/ 'dam mar pad+ma dang*/ lus med ma dang*/ gzhon nu ma dang*/ ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma dang*/ rin chen 'phreng ba ma dang*/ mig bzang ma dang*/ rul ma dang*/ bzang mos bskor ba/ thams cad dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na mdung thung dang*/ lcags kyu/

g.yon na rin po che dang zhags pa/ byang du drag mo gshin rjes 'khyud pa khyu mchog gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar 'dab mar gau rī ma dang*/ gaṅga ma dang*/ rtag ma dang*/ myur ma dang*/ to ta la dang*/ mtshon byed ma dang*/ dmar ser ma dang*/ nag mos bskor ba/ thams cad dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na rtse gsum dang*/ ḍā ma ru/ g.yon na khaṭ+wāṃ ga dang sbrul/ dbang ldan du dpal chen mo gdong drug gis 'khyud pa seng ge'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar 'dab mar dpal ldan dkar mo dang*/ zla ba'i ri mo dang*/ ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdong ma dang*/ ngang pa'i mdog ma dang*/ 'dzin ma dang*/ pad+ma'i dbang mo dang*/ skar mig ma dang*/ dri med ri bong 'dzin mas bskor ba/ thams cad dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na pad+ma dang*/ bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon na me tog dang rin po che nub tu dbang mo bden bral gyis 'khyud pa/ glang po che'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar 'dab mar rdo rje 'od ma dang*/ rdo rje'i lus ma dang*/ gser ldan ma dang*/ u ra ba sī dang*/ bkra ba'i ri mo dang*/ ram+bha dang*/ zug rngu med ma dang*/ shin tu sgrol mas bskor ba/ thams cad ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na rdo rje dang*/ mda'/ g.yon na dril bu dang gzhu/ rlung du tshangs ma gdong bzhi khyab 'jug gis 'khyud pa ngang pa'i steng gi pad ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar sā bi trī dang*/ pad+ma'i mig dang*/ chu skyes can ma dang*/ blo ma dang*/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma dang*/ ga ma trī dang*/ glog ma dang*/ bran mas bskor ba/ thams cad ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na pad+ma dang*/ tshangs pa'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon na spyi blugs dang lhung bzed/ gtso mo rnams sa ga'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa yab rnams sa ga'i stabs kyis 'khyud pa/ 'khor rnams ni rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ rang rigs kyi phyag rgyas btab pa'i cod pan sogs lha'i rgyan dang gos kyis spras pa/

sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi snam bu'i shar sgo'i g.yas su srin po dzṛ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa ro dmar po'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar nya rdo rje ma sogs nag pa zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo nyer brgyad 'dab ma rim pa gsum la rim pa bzhin bskor ba thams cad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas ral gri dang gri gug g.yon na phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mer rlung lha dz+ṝ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ sha ba'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar tsā rdo rje ma sogs sa ga zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas na dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du ba'i me tog g.yon na in+d+ra nī la dang ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ lho sgo'i g.yas su me lha ḍ+ṝ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa lug gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar 'dab mar ṇa rdo rje ma sogs snon gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas shak+ti dang*/ dbyug pa/ g.yon na pad+ma dang*/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdong drug ḍ+ṝ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa rma bya'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar ṭā rdo rje ma sogs chu stod zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na mdung thung dang mdung*/ g.yon na rin po che dang*/ me long 'dzin pa/ byang sgo'i g.yas su chu lha bṛ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa chu srin gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar mā rdo rje ma sogs gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas na zhags pa dang*/ rin po che/ g.yon na sbrul zhags dang zla ba chu shel 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du tshogs bdag bṝ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa byi ba'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab dmar sā rdo rje ma sogs khrums stod zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/

thams cad dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas na dgra sta dang rdo rje/ g.yon na zhags pa dang*/ rin po che/ nub sgo'i g.yas su dbang po drī rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ glang po che'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar nā rdo rje ma sogs tha skar zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ me'i mda'/ g.yon dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rlung du tshangs pa drī rdo rje mas 'khyud pa ngang pa'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar tā rdo rje ma sogs smin drug zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na khab dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon na pad+ma dang*/ spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon du drag po ṣara'-i rdo rje mas 'khyud pa khyu mchog gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar ྈྐ rdo rje ma sogs mgo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rtse gsum dang mda'/ g.yon na khaṭ+wāṃ ga sbrul dang bcas pa'i gzhu 'dzin pa/ nub sgo'i g.yon du gnod sbyin ṣara'-i rdo rje mas 'khyud pa seng ge'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar sā rdo rje ma sogs rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na rin po che dang*/ be con/ g.yon na ne'u le dang*/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du khyab 'jug gṛ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa nam mkha' lding gi steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar rdo rje ma sogs mchu'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ thams cad ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas na 'khor lo dang*/ dbyug tho/ g.yon na pad+ma dang*/ skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon du gshin rje gṝ rdo rje mas 'khyud pa ma he'i steng gi pad+ma'i lte bar/ 'dab mar kā rdo rje ma sogs dbo'i zla ba'i tshes kyi lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/

thams cad sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon na lcags sgrog dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbang po la phyogs pa'i tshul gyis gtso bo rnams rdo rje'i gdan gyis lha mo rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gnod mdzes lta bu'i shin tu sngon mos 'khyud pa'i gtsug tor can ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis dgra sta dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na sbrul zhags dang khaṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa steng gi nam mkha' lding a nī las drang ba'i shing rta la/ shar sgor stobs po che lta bu'i 'od zer can mas 'khyud pa'i dbyug sngon can nag po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na phub dang sbrul 'dzin pa/ phag nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ lho sgor mi g.yo ba lta bu'i tsun+das 'khyud pa'i 'dod rgyal dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis na gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rta dmar po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ byang sgor 'dod rgyal lta bu'i khro gnyer can mas 'khyud pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na tho ba dang*/ mdung*/ g.yon gnyis na pad+ma dang*/ me long 'dzin pa seng ge dkar mo bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ nub sgor dbyug sngon lta bu'i lcags sgrog mas 'khyud pa'i stobs po che ser po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na 'khor lo dang*/ dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang*/ rin po che 'dzin pa glang po che ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/ gtsug tor can lta bu'i drag can mas 'khyud pa'i gnod mdzes sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sa 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pas drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du/

thams cad skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rang rigs kyi cod pan can/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa gdong re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas brkyang gis stabs kyis gnas pa la khro mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis 'khyud pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs bzhi'i ka ba brgyad kyi 'og tu 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la stobs rgyu dang*/ pad+ma nag po lce spyang gdong ma dang*/ mkha' lding gdong mas 'khyud pa shar/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po/ stag gdong ma dang*/ 'ug gdong mas 'khyud pa lhor/ rigs ldan dang mtha' yas dkar po/ phag gdong ma dang bya rgod gdong mas 'khyud pa byang*/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po/ khyi gdong ma dang*/ bya rog gdong mas 'khyud pa nub/ thams cad kyang sbrul mgo lnga pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas na bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon na pad+ma dang*/ rin po che 'dzin pa lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ rdo rje'i gdan sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan du zla ba/ bden bral du nyi ma/ me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams shar rtse mos 'bigs pa'i dur khrod du bse'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ khyi gdong ma nag mo/ me lhag ma za ba'i dur khrod du bhe run+ḍa'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ bya gdong ma nag mo// lhor ro sreg pa'i dur khrod du/ dom gyi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ phag gdong ma dmar mo/ lho nub mi bzad pa'i g.yul gyi dur khrod du/ khrung khrung gi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ bya rgod gdong ma dmar mo byang rul pa dang bcas pa'i dur khrod du/ 'bri'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ stag gdong ma dkar mo// dbang ldan byis pa shi ba'i dur khrod du bshang gdong gi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ 'ug gdong ma dkar mo/ nub rnag gi dri'i dur khrod du seng ge'i steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/

ce spyang gdong ma ser mo/ rlung sbrul gyis zos pa'i dur khrod du/ mig sngon gyi steng gi 'khor lo'i lte bar/ mkha' lding gdong ma ser mo// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis// gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ klus 'khyud pa/ gzhan yang ma mo dang*/ klu dang*/ srin po dang*/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ zhing chen dang*/ gza' dang*/ ri bo dang*/ me lha dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ ro dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ lo dang*/ zla ba dang*/ zhag dang*/ dus kyi lha rgyu skar dang dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can dang*/ nag po chen po dang*/ zhing skyong thams cad dang*/ pho nya thams cad dang*/ 'phrog ma dang*/ grub pa bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhis gang ba ces pa rlung gi nang tsam du dgod par bshad do// thugs kyi snam bu'i kha khyer la mchod pa'i gzungs ma/ gsung la 'dod ma so drug 'dir dur khrod la dgod par/ sku'i la phyir 'dod ma sum cu so drug steng 'og gnas pa'i klu rgyal ba rnam rgyal dang*/ rab gtum ma sngon mo rdo rje'i mig gnyis rnams 'khod par gyur/ thams cad sku stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo la sogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ji ltar gzhan la phan par nus pa'i chos ston pa la sogs pas gzhan bsod nams kyi tshogs mthar phyin pa la bzhag slar bsdu bar byas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhak+ṣamalawarayaṃ

snying po'o// 'jigs med chu 'dzin bzang po des/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho nas blangs pa'i// mngon rtogs char gyi thar dod gzhi// dag par rlon 'di pad dkar dbyar// rnal 'byor rdzogs - pa'i 'phreng ba ji lta ba'i mngon rtogs 'dzin bde bar sbyar ba legs bshad gzhan phan mtha' yas pa 'di/ pad+ma dkar pos bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i dmag sde'i dbus/ thub bstan lang tsho bdo ba'i thang*/ byams pa chen po'i chos kyi gling du sbyar ba kun tu khyab par gyur cig/ //
